The company provides investor relations and ESG reporting on its public website but does not publish a developer API; partner integrations occur through industry-standard EDI, terminal automation, and ticketing systems.

providers.name: Stifel Financial
providers.description: Stifel Financial is a financial services holding company whose subsidiaries provide securities brokerage, investment banking, trading, investment advisory, and related financial services to individual investors, corporations, and government entities. Stifel bank accounts are accessible via open banking data aggregators including Plaid and Finicity (Mastercard) for third-party financial applications.

providers.name: Comerica
providers.description: Comerica Incorporated is a Texas-headquartered super-regional financial services holding company providing retail, small-business, commercial, and wealth-management banking across the United States, with market concentrations in Texas, California, Michigan, Arizona, and Florida. As of July 2026 Comerica publishes NO first-party developer API portal: developer.comerica.com, api.comerica.com, and related developer subdomains do not resolve, and directory trackers (Open Banking Tracker, API Tracker) list no documented API products, OpenAPI/Swagger specs, SDKs, or Postman collections. Consumer and small-business account data is reached indirectly through US open-finance aggregators (Plaid, MX, Finicity, Akoya) and through Financial Data Exchange (FDX) APIs — the CFPB-recognized standard-setting body for the Section 1033 Personal Financial Data Rights rule — rather than a Comerica-published endpoint. Commercial treasury, cash-positioning, ACH/wire initiation, and reporting are delivered through Comerica's Cash Management and Commercial Information Management platforms under direct customer contract (host-to-host files, portal, and BAI/ISO 20022 feeds), not a public REST API. Note: Fifth Third Bancorp completed its all-stock acquisition of Comerica in February 2026, so Comerica's future digital and API surface is being integrated into Fifth Third's platform.

providers.name: Kyros College Prep
providers.description: Kyros (kyros.ai) is an AI-driven college preparation and admissions platform. In the company's own words, it is "a College Prep Platform by former Googlers, Admissions Officers, and Professors" that "uses AI to offer 100K+ summer and financial aid programs." The product combines student assessments for college and major fit, one-on-one counseling, college essay and letter-of-recommendation support, extracurricular and summer-program discovery, and structured program tracks such as Future You Lab, the UC Bootcamp, and industry immersion and research programs. Kyros also sells through partner channels, with education-partner, VAR, counselor-advisory, college-success, and Fortune 1000 employer offerings, and publishes a large admissions blog. As of 2026-07-19 Kyros publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API description.

providers.name: Telephone and Data Systems
providers.description: Telephone and Data Systems (TDS) is a diversified telecommunications holding company providing broadband, video, and voice services across the United States through its subsidiary TDS Telecom, and wireless infrastructure through Array Digital Infrastructure (formerly U.S. Cellular). TDS serves customers in rural and suburban communities across 30 states, delivering fiber-based broadband and advanced connectivity solutions.

providers.name: TJX Companies
providers.description: The TJX Companies, Inc. is an American multinational off-price department store corporation headquartered in Framingham, Massachusetts, ranked No. 80 on the 2024 Fortune 500 list. Operating over 4,800 stores across nine countries and three continents under brands including T.J. Maxx, Marshalls, HomeGoods, Sierra, HomeSense (US), and Winners, HomeSense, Marshalls (Canada), TJX provides supplier and vendor integration through EDI and web-based portal platforms. Supplier connectivity is handled via Oracle iSupplier, SupplierOne, and the DiCentral ASN Vendor Portal, supporting purchase orders, advanced shipping notices, invoicing, and payment tracking.

providers.name: QXO Building Products
providers.description: QXO is a publicly traded company focused on building a tech-forward leader in the building products distribution industry through acquisitions and operational improvements. QXO offers a suite of customer-facing APIs for ordering, pricing, account management, product catalog, delivery tracking, and invoicing.

providers.name: Vectren (CenterPoint Energy)
providers.description: Vectren Corporation was a Fortune 1000 energy holding company headquartered in Evansville (Newburgh), Indiana providing regulated natural gas and electric distribution services to customers in Indiana and Ohio, along with non-regulated infrastructure services and energy efficiency programs. Vectren merged with CenterPoint Energy on February 1, 2019 in a $6 billion transaction, becoming part of the combined company which serves over 7 million metered customers across Arkansas, Indiana, Louisiana, Minnesota, Mississippi, Ohio, Oklahoma, and Texas. Vectren customer-facing portals continue to operate at vectren.com redirecting to CenterPoint Energy services.

providers.name: AMERCO
providers.description: AMERCO, operating as U-Haul Holding Company, is America's largest do-it-yourself moving and storage company. The company provides truck and trailer rentals, self-storage facilities, moving supplies, and portable moving and storage containers through its U-Haul brand. AMERCO operates the Moving Help marketplace connecting consumers to moving service providers, the U-Haul Self-Storage Affiliate Network, and WebSelfStorage management software for independent storage facilities. It also operates AMERITAS Life Insurance and Oxford Life Insurance subsidiaries.

providers.name: Labcorp
providers.description: Labcorp helps patients, providers, organizations, and biopharma companies guide vital healthcare decisions every day. Labcorp supports HL7 / FHIR-based integration for laboratory orders and results exchange with electronic health record (EHR) systems, but does not publish a fully open public developer portal; access is granted through health-system and biopharma integration agreements.

providers.name: Ameren
providers.description: Ameren Corporation is a regulated electric and natural gas utility serving customers in Missouri and Illinois. The company provides reliable energy delivery, smart grid infrastructure, and renewable energy programs. Ameren Illinois implements the Green Button Connect My Data program (Share My Usage) based on the ESPI standard, enabling authorized third parties to access customer energy usage data. Ameren also operates a Renewables Portal for community solar generation owners and participates in grid modernization initiatives.

providers.name: Catalant
providers.description: Catalant is a consulting platform that connects organizations with a global marketplace of experienced independent consultants and boutique firms, positioning itself as "Consulting 2.0" fit-to-purpose consulting that is faster, more flexible, and more cost efficient than traditional large consulting firms. Its network spans 10,000+ vetted consultants (many from Fortune 500 companies and top-tier consulting firms, averaging 19+ years of experience) and serves 700+ businesses across 20+ countries. Catalant covers engagement areas including Digital & AI, Transformation & Value Creation, Operations, Sales & Marketing, M&A / Integration & Separation, Strategy & Finance, and Organization & People. Catalant is a General Catalyst portfolio company. No public developer API or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company's public web, legal, and support properties.

providers.name: DevAI
providers.description: DevAI (DevAI Solutions, Inc.) is a Silicon Valley enterprise IT company, founded in 2024 by Susie Wee (CEO) and Edwin Zhang, that builds agentic AI for IT operations teams. Its DevAI Network Intelligence Engine reconciles data across fragmented IT tools of record (CMDB, vCenter, NetBox and other infrastructure, network, compute, and security systems) into a single trustworthy operational view, and its Network Intelligence Agent "Neo" streamlines IT planning, incident response, patch management, and security and compliance workflows through a chat interface. DevAI reports deployment at Fortune 50 enterprises and won Best-in-Show (Automation) at the AI Networking Summit 2025. The company raised a $6M seed round led by Emergence Capital with Pear VC, Base10 Partners, and Benchstrength. No public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal has been published to date; this profile captures the company identity and the security posture of its public web surface.

providers.name: M&T Bank
providers.description: M&T Bank is a regional bank holding company headquartered in Buffalo, New York, providing commercial and retail banking services to consumers and businesses across the eastern United States. As a subsidiary of M&T Bank Corporation (NYSE: MTB), it offers checking, savings, lending, mortgage, wealth management, and treasury services.

providers.name: M&T Bank Corporation
providers.description: M&T Bank Corporation (NYSE: MTB) is a regional financial services holding company headquartered in Buffalo, New York that provides commercial and retail banking services through its principal subsidiary M&T Bank to consumers and businesses across the eastern United States. The company offers checking, savings, lending, mortgage, wealth management, and treasury services.

providers.name: TriNet
providers.description: TriNet is a Dublin, California-based professional employer organization (PEO) for small and mid-market businesses, founded in 1988 by Martin Babinec and led today by President and CEO Mike Simonds. TriNet delivers full-service HR through a co-employment model — payroll processing, Fortune-500-grade health, retirement and ancillary benefits, workers' compensation, employment-practices liability coverage, compliance and risk management, and strategic HR advisory — to thousands of SMBs across the United States. The company offers two main packages: TriNet PEO (full co-employment) and HR Plus (technology platform plus support). TriNet is publicly traded on the NYSE as TNET with trailing-twelve-month revenue of roughly $5.0B as of FY2025. TriNet exposes its HR Customer Platform through three SwaggerHub-documented API groups — DCP, HRIS, and PEO — covering Employees, Companies, Payroll, Money, and Time-Off domains, with API credentials issued to approved customers and Integration Center partners rather than offered as a fully open developer program; OpenAPI/Swagger, Postman/Insomnia collections, a sandbox, OAuth playground, and webhook management are available to authorized developers. Public 1:1 API access typically requires partner-program qualification and technical review, which is why most TriNet customers consume the platform via the curated Integration Center marketplace (accounting, HRIS, identity, ATS, payroll, benefits and learning partners) or via unified-API aggregators such as Finch, Merge, Apideck and Truto.

providers.name: A.Team
providers.description: A.Team is an enterprise AI talent network that connects companies with elite, pre-vetted tech builders — senior engineers, product managers, designers, and data scientists — to design, build, and scale AI products and solutions. The platform matches Fortune 500 companies and high-growth startups with dedicated talent and full cross-functional "expert teams," and increasingly delivers packaged AI agent solutions (voice agents, market-data and reporting agents, legal-document and due-diligence agents, municipal-code workflow agents) that integrate into existing tools like Slack, Teams, PowerPoint, and Excel. A.Team operates as a services and talent-marketplace business rather than a self-service developer API provider; it exposes no public API, developer portal, or API documentation. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: GE Vernova
providers.description: GE Vernova is accelerating the path to more reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy through its innovative portfolio of electrification, power, and decarbonization technologies. Spun off from General Electric, GE Vernova brings together the legacy GE Power, Renewable Energy, Digital, and Energy Financial Services businesses to help solve the world's energy transition challenges.

bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

providers.name: CenterPoint Energy
providers.description: CenterPoint Energy is a domestic energy delivery company that provides electric transmission and distribution, natural gas distribution, and energy services operations serving residential, commercial, and industrial customers across multiple U.S. states. Developer-facing interfaces include the Smart Meter Texas (SMT) Usage History Inquiry API, Green Button Connect My Data exports for authorized third-party access to customer interval usage, and the Centerpoint Connect service API at api-portal.centerpointconnect.io used by contractor and field-service integrations.

providers.name: SM Energy
providers.description: SM Energy Company (NYSE: SM) is an independent oil and gas exploration and production company headquartered in Denver, Colorado. Founded in 1908 (originally as St. Mary Land & Exploration Company), SM Energy focuses on acquiring, exploring, developing, and producing crude oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquids (NGLs) from top-tier assets across the Permian Basin in West Texas and New Mexico, the Maverick Basin in South Texas, the DJ Basin in Colorado, and the Uinta Basin in northeast Utah. The company is a Fortune 1000 member with approximately 1,241 employees and average daily net production of 206.8 MBoe/d. SM Energy completed a merger with Civitas Resources in early 2026. The company does not offer a public developer API; investor data is accessible through financial data APIs and SEC EDGAR.

providers.name: Hub
providers.description: Hub (Hub.xyz) is a distributed physical-AI data infrastructure company that creates, annotates, and curates custom real-world datasets — egocentric first-person video, image, video, and audio — used to train AI and robotics models. Data is sourced through a global network of 500,000+ retail contributors and verified small and medium businesses across 150+ countries and 100+ languages. Hub offers both off-the-shelf labeled datasets and bespoke, custom-scoped data collection projects quoted within hours, delivered through a fully managed pipeline that couples automation with human-in-the-loop validation for frontier AI labs and Fortune 500 companies.

providers.name: Lavante
providers.description: Lavante was a SaaS supplier information management (SIM) and profit-recovery company built on its patented Lavante Connect platform. Its products — Lavante SIM, Lavante Recovery and Vendor File Cleanse — cleansed vendor master files, verified addresses and TINs, ran OFAC screening, onboarded suppliers onto the Lavante Supplier Network, and drove dispute resolution and recovery audit across the procure-to-pay (P2P) ecosystem for Fortune 1000 clients in hospitality, retail, entertainment, manufacturing and medical. Lavante was acquired by PRGX Global and its standalone site was retired; www.lavante.com now 302-redirects to www.prgx.com, where the supplier-facing capability lives on as PRGX Supplier Connect. Lavante never published a public API, developer portal, SDKs or API documentation — the Internet Archive holds no api/developer/docs/swagger paths for the domain.

providers.name: StanCorp Financial Group
providers.description: StanCorp Financial Group, Inc. (doing business as The Standard) is an insurance and financial services company headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and a wholly-owned subsidiary of Meiji Yasuda Life Insurance Company since 2016. Founded in 1906, The Standard offers group and individual disability insurance, group life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance, group dental and group vision insurance, absence management services, retirement plans, individual annuities, and commercial mortgage loan origination. The Standard does not offer a public developer API. Employer and benefits administrator integrations are managed through EDI and proprietary data exchange channels.

providers.name: Boeing
providers.description: Boeing is an American multinational corporation that designs, manufactures, and sells airplanes, rotorcraft, rockets, satellites, and telecommunications equipment. Boeing Developer Tools provides aviation data APIs powered by Jeppesen aeronautical databases, covering aircraft models, airport data, airspace information, NOTAMs, flight events, and runway operations.

providers.name: River Health
providers.description: River Health is an employer-sponsored virtual-first health plan operated by Mountain (joinmountain.com) that gives employees comprehensive primary and behavioral care at no cost to them. Members get unlimited virtual primary care and in-person doctor visits, behavioral health and therapy, thousands of free medications with home delivery or pharmacy pickup, free preventive care and screenings, after-hours urgent care, no-cost specialty and chronic- condition care, and free lab testing through Quest Diagnostics. Employers from small businesses to the Fortune 500 sponsor the plan; members enroll and manage care through the River Health member app at app.helloriver.com. River Health is a portfolio company of Techstars. No public developer API, documentation, or developer portal has been published.

providers.name: Rohirrim
providers.description: Rohirrim is an AI-native Unified Acquisition Platform that automates and accelerates government procurement for both agencies and contractors. Its UnifiedAcquire product helps government agencies manage procurements from market research through award by automating acquisition documents and centralizing institutional knowledge, while UnifiedRespond (RohanRFP) helps companies identify, match, and draft RFP responses faster and at lower cost. The company targets federal agencies, government contractors, Fortune 500 firms, and healthcare organizations, and is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Insight Partners. Rohirrim publishes no public developer API surface today; this profile captures its public web, content, and security-posture footprint.

providers.name: Albemarle
providers.description: Albemarle Corporation is a global specialty chemicals company and leading provider of lithium, bromine, and other essential elements. Operating from its global headquarters in Charlotte, NC, Albemarle serves customers in approximately 70 countries with world-class hard-rock and brine lithium resources, state-of-the-art lithium conversion facilities, advanced lithium material and process development, bromine production facilities, and the US's only producing lithium resource in Silver Peak, NV. The company serves critical markets including electric vehicle batteries, energy storage, flame retardants, pharmaceutical ingredients, catalysts, and specialty chemicals, employing approximately 7,800 people and holding over 1,500 active patents worldwide.

providers.name: Compass
providers.description: Compass is a leading real estate technology company headquartered in New York City that provides a tech-enabled brokerage platform connecting agents, buyers, and sellers across the United States. The company combines residential real estate services with proprietary software for agents, including marketing, client management, and listing tools. Compass does not currently publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: Simon Property Group
providers.description: Simon Property Group is the largest retail real estate investment trust (REIT) in the United States, owning, developing, and managing premier shopping, dining, entertainment, and mixed-use destinations. Simon's portfolio includes an interest in 254 properties: traditional malls, premium outlets, Mills centers, lifestyle centers, and other retail properties in North America, Europe, and Asia. The company operates ShopSimon, an e-commerce platform, and Simon Innovation Group to advance retail technology innovation. Simon had trailing twelve-month revenue of approximately $6.36 billion as of 2025 and a market capitalization of approximately $67 billion.

providers.name: Aaron's
providers.description: Aaron's is a lease-to-own retailer of furniture, consumer electronics, home appliances, and accessories serving customers across the United States and Canada. They provide flexible payment options including rent-to-own leasing with instant approval, online account management, and EZPay automatic payments.

providers.name: AMC Networks
providers.description: AMC Networks is a global entertainment company that owns and operates distinctive cable television and streaming brands including AMC, BBC America, IFC, Sundance TV, and We TV, as well as the AMC+ streaming service. The company operates 33 FAST channels across 22 platforms and delivers digital advertising through its Audience+ data platform. AMC Networks provides affiliate partnership services, advertising solutions, and streaming content distribution through its network of cable and digital properties.

providers.name: CIT Group
providers.description: CIT Group was a US financial holding company providing commercial financing, equipment leasing, factoring, and middle-market banking services. CIT was acquired by First Citizens BancShares in January 2022 and has been integrated into First Citizens Bank as the Commercial Banking division. CIT Group does not maintain a public developer portal and never published general-purpose REST APIs; legacy customer integrations were delivered through file-based ACH/wire feeds, the OneWest online banking platform, and partner-mediated treasury connectivity. New API-based integrations for the combined institution are now exposed through First Citizens Bank.

providers.name: First American Financial
providers.description: First American Financial is a leading provider of title insurance, settlement services, and risk solutions for real estate transactions, as well as related products and services. First American operates a developer portal exposing APIs for office lookup, order management, document exchange, messaging, and webhook notifications.

providers.name: XPO
providers.description: XPO, Inc. (NYSE: XPO) is a Fortune 500 transportation company and one of the largest providers of less-than-truckload (LTL) freight transportation in North America. Following the spin-offs of GXO Logistics (contract logistics, 2021) and RXO (brokerage, 2022), XPO is now a pure-play LTL trucking company operating a network of service centers across the United States and Mexico. XPO does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; customer integrations (rate quotes, shipment tracking, EDI) are arranged through enterprise account managers and standard EDI exchanges.

providers.name: XPO Logistics
providers.description: XPO Logistics, Inc. is a leading provider of less-than-truckload (LTL) transportation in North America. The company offers freight transportation through a proprietary network of service centers and uses technology to drive efficiency for more than 50,000 customers. XPO Logistics historically operated as part of XPO, Inc. (NYSE: XPO), the publicly traded company that spun off GXO Logistics (contract logistics) in 2021 and RXO (brokerage) in 2022, leaving XPO focused on LTL trucking. XPO Logistics does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; integrations are arranged through enterprise account managers.

providers.name: Laboratory Corporation of America (Labcorp)
providers.description: Laboratory Corporation of America Holdings, doing business as Labcorp, is a leading global life sciences company providing diagnostic, drug development, and technology-enabled solutions to improve health and lives. This repository is an alias of the labcorp index and tracks the same FHIR / HL7 integration surface.

providers.name: Lennar
providers.description: Lennar Corporation is a Fortune 500 company and one of the leading homebuilders of new homes for sale in the United States. Lennar operates an internal Azure-hosted API Management developer portal where Lennar developers and partners discover and consume Lennar Corporation APIs. Public OpenAPI artifacts have not been observed; access generally requires sign-in and partner approval.

providers.name: Republic Services
providers.description: Republic Services is one of the largest providers of non-hazardous solid waste disposal, recycling, and environmental services in the United States. As a Fortune 500 company, Republic Services serves millions of customers across residential, commercial, industrial, and environmental segments. The company offers waste collection, recycling processing, composting, landfill operations, and digital customer tools for account management, service scheduling, and environmental reporting.

providers.name: Ball Corporation
providers.description: Ball Corporation is a global supplier of sustainable aluminum packaging for beverage, food, personal care, and household products, as well as aerospace and other technologies and services for commercial and government customers. Ball operates more than 80 manufacturing plants worldwide and is a leader in aluminum can sustainability and recycling.

providers.name: Raymond James Financial
providers.description: Raymond James Financial is a diversified financial services holding company headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, providing investment banking, wealth management, capital markets, asset management, and banking services to individuals, corporations, and municipalities. With more than 7,100 financial advisors serving approximately 3 million client accounts and total client assets exceeding $637 billion, Raymond James is a Fortune 500 firm and one of the largest independent broker-dealers in the United States. The company offers client-facing portals and mobile apps for account management and reporting but does not publish a general-purpose public developer API or machine-readable specification at this time.

providers.name: Seaboard
providers.description: Seaboard Corporation is a diverse global agribusiness and transportation company involved in pork, commodity merchandising, grain processing, sugar production, electric power generation, and ocean transportation.

providers.name: Skyworks Solutions
providers.description: Skyworks Solutions, Inc. is an American semiconductor company headquartered in Irvine, California that designs, develops, and markets proprietary semiconductor products for wireless communications, automotive, broadband, connected home, industrial, defense, and consumer electronics applications. Skyworks is a leading provider of analog and mixed-signal semiconductors, with dominant market share in 5G RF front-end modules (35% market share). Products span amplifiers, filters, front-end modules, isolators, switches, and power management ICs serving mobile, automotive, IoT, and infrastructure markets. The company does not publish a public developer API but provides datasheets, evaluation tools, and design resources for hardware engineers.

providers.name: W. R. Berkley
providers.description: W. R. Berkley Corporation is one of the largest commercial lines property and casualty insurance holding companies in the United States, operating through more than 60 operating units in approximately 60 countries. The company operates across two business segments: Insurance and Reinsurance and Monoline. Subsidiaries include BerkleyNet (workers' compensation), Berkley Risk Administrators, and others. W. R. Berkley does not offer a public developer API, though subsidiary portals and agent portals provide limited policy, billing, and claims access.

providers.name: Abbott Laboratories
providers.description: Abbott Laboratories is a global healthcare company that develops, manufactures, and markets pharmaceuticals, medical devices, diagnostics, and nutritional products. Abbott's digital health portfolio includes the FreeStyle Libre continuous glucose monitoring system, cardiac monitoring devices, and connected diagnostics platforms that enable data sharing between patients, caregivers, and healthcare providers.

providers.name: American Axle and Manufacturing
providers.description: American Axle & Manufacturing (AAM), now operating as Dauch Corporation following the February 2026 acquisition of Dowlais Group (GKN Automotive and GKN Powder Metallurgy), is a global Tier 1 automotive supplier designing, engineering, and manufacturing driveline and metal forming technologies for electric, hybrid, and internal combustion vehicles. AAM operates an iSupplier Portal for supplier communication, EDI integration for forecasts and releases, and the Demand AAM aftermarket parts portal.

providers.name: Asbury Automotive Group
providers.description: Asbury Automotive Group is one of the largest automotive retailers in the United States, operating new and used vehicle dealerships across multiple states and brands. Headquartered in Duluth, Georgia, Asbury operates approximately 200 dealerships representing 30+ automotive brands including luxury and non-luxury vehicles. The company operates under multiple brand names including Coggin Automotive Group, Crown Automotive Group, Park Place Dealerships, Nalley Automotive Group, and others. Asbury does not expose a public developer API but operates digital retail platforms including Clicklane, their proprietary online vehicle purchase platform.

providers.name: Barnes & Noble
providers.description: Barnes & Noble is the largest retail bookseller in the United States and the operator of the Nook digital reading platform. Barnes & Noble does not currently publish a public general-purpose developer portal. Trade and affiliate partners integrate through B&N's affiliate program, the B&N Press self-publishing platform for independent authors, EDI-based wholesale channels with publishers, and the Nook content distribution and reading ecosystem.

providers.name: Ulta Beauty
providers.description: Ulta Beauty is the largest beauty retailer in the United States, offering cosmetics, fragrance, skin care products, hair care products, and salon services through retail stores and online. The company operates over 1,400 stores across all 50 states and an e-commerce platform. Ulta Beauty does not currently offer a public developer API, but provides an affiliate program through Impact for publishers and content creators.

providers.name: Centene
providers.description: Centene Corporation is a leading managed care organization providing government-sponsored healthcare programs including Medicaid, Medicare, and Health Insurance Marketplace plans. Centene operates a developer portal at partners.centene.com publishing FHIR-based interoperability APIs under the 21st Century Cures Act and CMS Interoperability and Patient Access Rule, including Patient Access, Provider Directory, and Provider RTR (Payer Data Exchange) APIs.

providers.name: Eastman Chemical
providers.description: Driven by more than 100 years of continuous innovation, Eastman is a global Fortune 500 specialty materials company that produces a broad range of advanced materials, chemicals, and fibers used in everyday products. Eastman operates a customer-facing Customer Center for orders, documents, and Safety Data Sheets, but no public developer portal or REST API has been documented.

providers.name: AutoZone
providers.description: AutoZone is the nation's leading retailer and a leading distributor of automotive replacement parts and accessories with more than 7,000 stores across the Americas. AutoZone serves both do-it-yourself (DIY) customers and professional automotive service providers (DIFM) through retail stores, e-commerce, and electronic ordering integrations for commercial accounts via AutoZone Pro.

providers.name: CF Industries Holdings
providers.description: CF Industries Holdings is a Fortune 500 American manufacturer and distributor of nitrogen-based fertilizers (ammonia, urea, ammonium nitrate, UAN) and clean-energy products serving agricultural and industrial customers worldwide. CF operates one of the largest global ammonia production networks and is scaling clean (blue and green) ammonia for low-carbon energy. CF does not publish a public developer API program; programmatic data access is limited to investor-relations SEC filings feeds, press/news RSS, and partner EDI/B2B integrations with agricultural distributors, rail, terminal, and industrial customers.

providers.name: Jefferies Financial Group
providers.description: Jefferies Financial Group is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm providing advisory, capital raising, sales, trading, research, wealth management, and alternative asset management services to clients across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, and the Asia-Pacific.

providers.name: Science Applications International Corporation (SAIC)
providers.description: Science Applications International Corporation (SAIC) is a leading American technology integrator providing full life cycle services and solutions in the technical, engineering, and enterprise information technology markets. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, SAIC serves the U.S. federal government with approximately $7.4 billion in annual revenues. The company delivers IT modernization, cloud computing, digital transformation, cybersecurity, AI/ML, and data analytics solutions primarily for defense, intelligence, and civilian government customers. SAIC's open source presence is at github.com/saic-oss with DevSecOps tools including Anvil (CI/CD container) and terraform modules for Kubernetes sandboxes.

providers.name: CenturyLink (Lumen Technologies)
providers.description: CenturyLink is the residential broadband and home services brand of Lumen Technologies, a Fortune 500 telecommunications provider operating one of the largest fiber networks in North America. Following the Level 3 acquisition and rebrand to Lumen, CenturyLink's developer surface is exposed through the Lumen Developer Center and Lumen API Marketplace, which publish REST APIs secured by OAuth 2.0 for enterprise location qualification, quote-to-order, provisioning, billing, notifications, CDN and edge compute, DDoS mitigation, and Public Sector networking products.

providers.name: Domino's Pizza
providers.description: Domino's Pizza is a major US quick-service restaurant corporation and Fortune 1000 company. Domino's does NOT publish an official public developer API or a developer portal. Its digital ordering surface is delivered through consumer channels - the dominos.com website, the Domino's mobile apps, and the "AnyWare" ordering platform (text, voice, smart TV, Amazon Echo, Google Home, and more), including the "Dom" virtual voice ordering assistant. The undocumented HTTP endpoints behind these first-party apps have been reverse-engineered by the developer community into well-known UNOFFICIAL wrapper libraries (the npm "dominos" / node-dominos-pizza-api package and the Python "pizzapi" / "dominos" packages). These community libraries are not endorsed, supported, or warranted by Domino's. Domino's does expose APIs to select delivery-marketplace partners (e.g. Uber Eats, Just Eat) through direct partnership and a private Postman workspace, but these are not publicly available. No official API specification, pricing, or rate-limit policy is published.

providers.name: TreeHouse Foods
providers.description: TreeHouse Foods is one of the largest manufacturers of private label packaged foods and beverages in North America, producing snack and convenience foods for retail grocery and foodservice customers. The company is publicly traded on the NYSE (THS) and is headquartered in Oak Brook, Illinois. TreeHouse Foods produces over 1,600 SKUs across snacking, beverage, and meal preparation categories.

providers.name: West Technology Group
providers.description: West Technology Group is a cloud-based global technology company providing customer experience and communications solutions through its WestCX platform. The company operates through two main brands: Mosaicx, which delivers AI-native conversational automation for enterprise customer engagement, and TeleVox, which provides digital patient engagement solutions for healthcare organizations including providers, payers, and life sciences companies.

providers.name: Express Scripts Holding
providers.description: Express Scripts is a pharmacy benefit management (PBM) company, now part of Cigna's Evernorth Health Services, that processes prescription claims and provides home delivery and specialty pharmacy services for clients including health plans and employers. The Express Scripts Developer Portal exists for partner and client integrations, but its API catalog is not openly published; access is gated to authenticated partners.

providers.name: Fortinet
providers.description: Fortinet is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Fortinet API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Lennox International
providers.description: Lennox International is a global leader in the heating, air conditioning, and refrigeration markets, providing climate control solutions for residential and commercial applications. Lennox does not publish a general developer portal for HVAC system access. Smart-home integrations with the iComfort S30, E30, and M30 thermostat product lines are delivered through partnerships (Control4, Amazon Alexa, Apple HomeKit, Google Assistant, IFTTT) and through community-maintained, reverse-engineered Python and TypeScript libraries.

providers.name: AbbVie
providers.description: AbbVie is a research-based biopharmaceutical company that discovers, develops, manufactures, and markets advanced therapies in immunology, oncology, neuroscience, and other specialty areas. AbbVie's portfolio includes treatments for autoimmune diseases, various cancers, neurological disorders, and aesthetics through the Allergan Aesthetics portfolio.

providers.name: Alcoa
providers.description: Alcoa Corporation is a global industry leader in bauxite, alumina, and aluminum production. Founded in 1888, Alcoa operates mines, refineries, and smelters across Australia, Brazil, Canada, Iceland, Norway, Saudi Arabia, and the United States. The company is a Fortune 500 member and one of the world's largest aluminum producers, supplying lightweight, high-strength materials to automotive, aerospace, packaging, construction, and industrial markets. Alcoa is committed to sustainability through low-carbon aluminum production, responsible bauxite mining, and advancing aluminum recycling.

providers.name: DaVita
providers.description: DaVita Inc. is a Fortune 500 kidney care company operating in-center hemodialysis, home hemodialysis, and peritoneal dialysis programs in the United States and abroad, alongside transplant support, integrated kidney care, hospital partnerships, and clinical research. DaVita does not publish a public developer API; integration with the company is handled through patient-facing portals, payer and provider partnerships, and electronic health record data exchange standards.

providers.name: Westlake
providers.description: Westlake Corporation is a global Fortune 500 manufacturer and supplier of materials and innovative products that enhance life every day. The company produces chemical materials and building products across multiple sectors including packaging, healthcare, automotive, consumer goods, and construction. Westlake operates through two primary segments: Performance and Essential Materials (PEM) and Housing and Infrastructure Products (HIP), with net sales of approximately $11 billion annually.

providers.name: Cabot Corporation
providers.description: Cabot Corporation is a global specialty chemicals and performance materials company serving the transportation, infrastructure, environment, and consumer industries. The company's products include reinforcing carbons, specialty carbons, fumed silica, inkjet colorants, and engineered elastomer composites.

providers.name: First Data (Fiserv)
providers.description: First Data was a global payment technology solutions company providing merchant transaction processing, financial institution services, and prepaid services before merging with Fiserv in 2019. Legacy First Data API products including Payeezy, Bolt, and Commerce Hub are now part of the Fiserv developer portal.

providers.name: Fractal Analytics
providers.description: Fractal Analytics Limited (fractal.ai) is an enterprise artificial intelligence services and products company founded in 2000, headquartered in New York with a large delivery footprint in India and roughly 5,000 employees across 18 global locations. Fractal sells AI consulting, data engineering, decision-science and design services to Fortune 500 clients in consumer packaged goods, retail, healthcare and life sciences, technology/media/telecom, financial services, insurance and industrials, and builds products on top of that practice — most notably Cogentiq, its enterprise agentic AI platform (with MCP and agent gateways, low-code agent builder and pre-built domain agents), LLM Studio, and consumer/vertical brands including Flyfish, Asper.ai, Kalaido.ai, Vaidya.ai and iqigai. The company listed on the NSE and BSE under the symbol FRACTAL in February 2026. Its API surface is delivered inside client engagements and gated product tenants rather than through a public developer program: as of this profiling pass Fractal publishes no public developer portal, no OpenAPI or other machine-readable API contract, and no hosted MCP server or A2A agent card.

providers.name: Mint State Labs
providers.description: Mint State Labs (mintstatelabs.com, operating as Wildnet Edge) is an AI-first custom software development and IT outsourcing company delivering custom AI, machine learning, mobile, web, and cloud engineering services to enterprises and Fortune 500 clients. Its offerings span custom AI model and agent development, generative AI, ChatGPT app development, mobile and web app development, DevOps, data engineering, business intelligence, and staff augmentation ("build a team" / white-label) across a broad set of frameworks and platforms. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead; the public presence is a marketing and services site with no first-party API product, developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDK surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Tenex AI
providers.description: TENEX.AI is an AI-native, human-led Managed Detection and Response (MDR) provider that fuses agentic AI, automation, and elite human security analysts to run security operations at scale. Its platform triages every alert and investigates every threat, orchestrating workflows across 300+ security tools to deliver faster detection, high-fidelity triage, and autonomous response with human guardrails for Fortune 500 and Global 2000 enterprises. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Crosspoint Capital, and Shield Capital, TENEX.AI operates as a managed cybersecurity service rather than a public developer API platform; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: CBS (Paramount Global)
providers.description: CBS is the flagship broadcast television network of Paramount Global (NASDAQ: PARA, PARAA). It encompasses CBS Entertainment, CBS News, CBS Sports, CBS Stations (owned and operated), and feeds Paramount+ streaming service. CBS does not publish a consumer developer portal. Partner, syndication, advertising, and distribution APIs are operated privately through Paramount Global's business development, ad sales, and affiliate operations teams.

providers.name: Fidelity National Information Services (FIS)
providers.description: Fidelity National Information Services (FIS) is a global provider of financial services technology offering solutions across retail and institutional banking, payments, asset and wealth management, risk and compliance, and outsourcing. FIS exposes APIs to financial institutions, fintechs, and corporates through its Code Connect API marketplace.

providers.name: Kroger
providers.description: Partner APIs related to integrating with a full-service delivery partner.

providers.name: Corning
providers.description: Corning Incorporated is a Fortune 500 American technology company that specializes in glass science, ceramic science, and optical physics. Founded in 1851, Corning manufactures specialty glass, ceramics, and related materials and technologies for industrial and scientific applications. Corning's businesses include Optical Communications (fiber optic cable and hardware), Display Technologies (LCD and OLED glass substrates), Specialty Materials (Gorilla Glass for mobile devices), Environmental Technologies (ceramic substrates and filters for emissions control), and Life Sciences (laboratory glassware, cell culture, and bioprocess products). Corning does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Medley
providers.description: Medley is a leadership development company that delivers group-based executive coaching at enterprise scale, pairing professional coaches with AI-enabled tooling to bring quality and a human touch to Fortune 500 organizations. Founded in 2020 by Edith Cooper and Jordan Taylor, the platform runs curated small-group coaching cohorts focused on trust, empathy, communication, and collaboration to drive organizational transformation. Medley raised a $3.7M seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). It operates as a B2B services and coaching platform and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Pool
providers.description: Pool.com is a Web3 domain service provider offering Infinity Domains, enabling ICANN-accredited registrars and other partners to mint and distribute Second Level Domains and integrate Web3 naming into their services through Pool's registrar API.

providers.name: Quantifind
providers.description: Quantifind is a financial crimes automation company founded in 2009 by physicists Ari Tuchman and John Stockton to extract meaningful risk signals from large, unstructured datasets. Its flagship SaaS platform, Graphyte, applies machine learning, natural language processing, and entity resolution to anti-money laundering (AML) and know-your-customer (KYC) compliance. Graphyte spans watchlist and sanctions screening, adverse media screening, enhanced due diligence, credit risk, and investigations, and is delivered through GraphyteSearch (an investigation application), GraphyteQueue (an AI-native case manager), GraphyteAPI (a synchronous REST risk-assessment API), and GraphyteBatch (batch screening). Quantifind serves Tier 1 and regional banks, digital banks, Fortune 50 companies, and federal and defense agencies, and integrates with case-management systems such as Oracle FCCM. Backed by a16z.

providers.name: Equifax
providers.description: Equifax is a consumer credit reporting agency that collects and aggregates information on individuals' credit history, including borrowing and repayment habits. This information is used by lenders and creditors to assess creditworthiness and make decisions about extending credit. Equifax also offers identity theft protection, credit monitoring, and fraud detection services, plus analytics and consulting offerings to help businesses manage risk.

providers.name: eXp World Holdings
providers.description: eXp World Holdings is the holding company for a portfolio of cloud-based, agent-centric real estate and technology businesses including eXp Realty, eXp Commercial, SUCCESS magazine, Frame, Realty Connect, and LuxVT. The company operates a virtual brokerage model powered by an immersive cloud workspace for agents. eXp World Holdings does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: Forwardlane
providers.description: ForwardLane Technologies builds Signal Studio, a decision intelligence platform that transforms enterprise data into auditable actions rather than dashboards. Users ask questions in natural language and receive Next Best Actions with complete audit trails in seconds, powered by a semantic data layer, multi-agent AI orchestration, a no-code signal builder, and in-database processing so data never leaves the customer environment. Validated across eight years of Fortune 500 production, Signal Studio serves financial services, private credit and private equity, real estate, energy and oil and gas, and government, with BYOK support for any LLM, cloud, or inference provider. Led by CEO Nathan Stevenson. ForwardLane exposes no public developer API surface; this profile captures the company's public identity and security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Prestige Consumer Healthcare
providers.description: Prestige Consumer Healthcare is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Prestige Consumer Healthcare API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: SLB (Schlumberger)
providers.description: SLB (Schlumberger) is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The SLB (Schlumberger) API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Belden
providers.description: Belden Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets networking, connectivity, and cable products and solutions for industrial automation, smart buildings, and broadcast markets. The company delivers end-to-end signal transmission solutions for mission-critical applications, including industrial Ethernet infrastructure, cybersecurity, and IIoT connectivity. Belden's Hirschmann brand is a leading provider of industrial network switches and management software with CLI, SNMP, and REST API interfaces for network device management.

providers.name: Brookdale Senior Living
providers.description: Brookdale Senior Living is one of the largest operators of senior living communities in the United States, offering independent living, assisted living, memory care, skilled nursing, continuing care retirement communities (CCRCs), and in-home care through Brookdale at Home. The company operates hundreds of communities across the US, serving tens of thousands of residents and their families.

providers.name: SunGard Data Systems
providers.description: SunGard Data Systems was a software and technology services company that provided software and processing solutions to financial services, education, and the public sector. In November 2015, SunGard was acquired by Fidelity National Information Services (FIS) for approximately $9.1 billion. Key product lines included SunGard Financial Systems (trading, treasury, risk management, capital markets), SunGard AvantGard (cash and liquidity management), SunGard K-12 (student information systems), and SunGard Higher Education (ERP for universities). Post-acquisition, these products were integrated into the FIS portfolio.

providers.name: YRC Worldwide
providers.description: YRC Worldwide (rebranded as Yellow Corporation in 2021) was a holding company whose subsidiaries — YRC Freight, Holland, Reddaway, New Penn, and HNRY Logistics — provided less-than-truckload (LTL) freight transportation, brokerage, and logistics services across North America. The company ceased operations on July 30, 2023 and filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy on August 6, 2023, ending nearly 100 years of operation. Bankruptcy asset sales redistributed terminals and equipment to Saia, XPO, Estes, and other carriers; no public developer APIs were ever published.

providers.name: CHS Inc.
providers.description: CHS Inc. is a Fortune 500 diversified, integrated, global agricultural cooperative owned by farmers, ranchers, cooperatives, and individual producers. Headquartered in Inver Grove Heights, Minnesota, CHS describes itself as the largest farmer-owned cooperative in the United States, with more than 750 member cooperatives, 75,000+ individual producer-owners, and 20,000+ preferred stockholders. The cooperative serves customers in 65 countries through three primary business divisions: Agriculture (crop nutrients, crop protection, precision agriculture, seed, animal nutrition, and oilseed products), Energy (refined fuels, propane, lubricants, pipelines, terminals, and renewable fuels under the Cenex brand), and Services (hedging, payment solutions, transportation, and capital services). Major brands include Cenex, Allegiant (seed), Payback (animal nutrition), and N-Edge (crop nutrients). CHS does not currently publish a public consumer-facing developer API; partner integrations are provided through digital platforms such as MyCHS (online portal for grain tickets, billing, and payments) and CHS Connect (digital self-service for crop protection and energy wholesale customers).

providers.name: Cimarex Energy
providers.description: Cimarex Energy was an independent oil and gas exploration and production company headquartered in Denver, Colorado, with operations focused in the Permian Basin and the Mid-Continent. In October 2021 Cimarex Energy combined with Cabot Oil & Gas Corporation to form Coterra Energy (NYSE: CTRA). No public Cimarex-branded developer APIs exist; all current digital channels and any future API offerings are part of Coterra Energy.

providers.name: Core & Main
providers.description: Core & Main is a leading specialty distributor of water, wastewater, storm drainage, and fire protection products and related services to municipalities, contractors, and engineers across the United States. As a Fortune 500 company, Core & Main operates more than 320 branch locations and provides products and services for water infrastructure, geosynthetics, fusible HDPE pipe, smart metering, fire protection, and erosion control.

providers.name: Crown Castle
providers.description: Crown Castle is a leading United States provider of shared communications infrastructure including cell towers, small cells, and fiber. Crown Castle owns and operates more than 40,000 cell towers and approximately 90,000 route miles of fiber, supporting wireless carriers, enterprises, and government customers with managed connectivity, dark fiber, optical encryption, ultra-low-latency transport, and managed SD-WAN services. Crown Castle does not currently publish a public developer API program; technical integrations are handled through customer and channel partner agreements.

providers.name: Exelon
providers.description: Exelon Corporation is one of the largest energy delivery companies in the United States, serving more than 10 million customers through its regulated electric and gas utility subsidiaries: Atlantic City Electric, BGE, ComEd, Delmarva Power, PECO, and Pepco. Headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, Exelon operates across multiple U.S. states. No public consumer-facing developer APIs have been identified for Exelon; customer self-service is conducted through utility portals.

providers.name: Kinder Morgan
providers.description: Kinder Morgan is one of the largest energy infrastructure companies in North America, owning and operating pipelines and terminals that transport natural gas, refined petroleum products, crude oil, carbon dioxide, and other commodities. Kinder Morgan publishes pipeline informational postings and capacity data through Electronic Bulletin Board (EBB) portals; no public REST API or developer program has been identified at this time.

providers.name: NGL Energy Partners
providers.description: NGL Energy Partners LP is a diversified midstream master limited partnership providing transportation, storage, blending, and marketing services for crude oil, natural gas liquids, refined products, and water solutions to producers and end-users across the energy industry. The company is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol NGL and operates three primary business units: Crude Oil Logistics, Water Solutions, and NGL Liquids.

providers.name: Tesoro
providers.description: Tesoro Corporation (later rebranded as Andeavor) was a Fortune 100 independent petroleum refiner and marketer headquartered in San Antonio, Texas. Founded in 1968, the company operated ten refineries in the Western United States with combined crude oil capacity of approximately 1.2 million barrels per day and approximately 3,000 branded retail gas stations. Tesoro rebranded as Andeavor in 2017 following its acquisition of Western Refining, and was acquired by Marathon Petroleum on October 1, 2018. No public developer API was offered.

providers.name: WESCO International
providers.description: WESCO International is a Fortune 500 leading provider of business-to-business distribution, logistics services, and supply chain solutions for electrical, industrial, communications, and utility customers worldwide. WESCO serves over 150,000 customers through a network of branches and distribution centers and provides comprehensive digital integration capabilities including EDI, punchout, cXML, and API connectivity for procurement automation.

providers.name: Worthington Industries
providers.description: Worthington Industries was a global diversified metals manufacturing company specializing in value-added steel processing and manufactured metal products. In December 2023, the company split into two publicly traded companies: Worthington Enterprises (consumer and building products) and Worthington Steel (flat-rolled steel processing, electrical steel laminations, and tailor-welded blanks). Worthington Industries does not offer a public developer API.

providers.name: Calumet
providers.description: Calumet is a specialty hydrocarbon and renewable fuels company that produces a broad portfolio of branded and customer-formulated specialty products including lubricating oils, white mineral oils, solvents, waxes, and renewable diesel through its Montana Renewables subsidiary. The company serves customers across consumer, industrial, and energy markets globally. Calumet does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: Swift Transportation
providers.description: Swift Transportation, now operating as Knight-Swift Transportation Holdings (KNX), is the largest full truckload motor carrier in North America. The company provides truckload, LTL, logistics, and intermodal transportation services across the US, Mexico, and Canada. Technology integration is primarily through EDI for freight tendering, shipment status, and invoicing workflows with trading partners and shippers.

providers.name: Universal Forest Products
providers.description: UFP Industries (formerly Universal Forest Products) is a leading global manufacturer and distributor of wood and wood-alternative products serving retail, industrial, and construction markets. UFP operates over 200 facilities globally supplying lumber, engineered wood products, packaging, and building materials. The company has integrated OnBase-based business system integration for document management and workflow automation across its supply chain operations.

providers.name: WEX
providers.description: Fortune 1000 company WEX. Public API documentation has not yet been catalogued in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: C. R. Bard
providers.description: C. R. Bard, Inc. was an American multinational developer, manufacturer, and marketer of medical technologies in the fields of vascular, urology, oncology, and surgical specialties. Bard was founded in 1907 by Charles Russell Bard and was acquired by Becton, Dickinson and Company (BD) in December 2017 for approximately $24 billion. Bard's product lines now operate as part of BD's Interventional segment under the BD Bard brand. No public API or developer portal is published; integrations with hospital and provider systems are arranged through BD enterprise channels.

providers.name: Church and Dwight
providers.description: Church & Dwight Co., Inc. is a Fortune 500 American consumer packaged goods (CPG) company headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, that manufactures and markets a portfolio of household, personal care, health and wellness, beauty, and specialty products. Best known as the parent company of the Arm & Hammer baking soda brand (the company's flagship since 1846), Church & Dwight operates through three reporting segments: Consumer Domestic, Consumer International, and Specialty Products Division. The company's brand portfolio includes Arm & Hammer, Trojan, OxiClean, Vitafusion, L'il Critters, Therabreath, Hero (Mighty Patch), Batiste, Waterpik, OraJel, Nair, Spinbrush, First Response, RepHresh, Zicam, Flawless, Toppik, Viviscal, Kaboom, Orange Glo, XTRA laundry detergent, and Arrid antiperspirant. Church & Dwight does not currently publish a public consumer-facing developer API; partner integrations are managed through internal portals, and consumer experiences focus on brand websites, e-commerce direct-to-consumer storefronts, and the Innovation Portal for external R&D partnerships.

providers.name: David AI
providers.description: David AI is an audio data research company building high-quality speech and conversational datasets to bring AI into the real world through voice. Using a rigorous six-step research process (hypothesize, design, experiment, evaluate, productionize, release), the team produces datasets such as Converse (channel-separated two-speaker English conversations), Atlas (multilingual data spanning 15+ languages with dialect and accent metadata), Chorus (multi-speaker conversations for speaker separation and diarization), and Dialog (expert domain conversations). Its data is licensed to Fortune 100 companies and research labs working on speech recognition, translation, synthesis, and conversational AI. Access is arranged through samples, consultation, and a data license agreement rather than a self-serve API. David AI is backed by Amplify Partners. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched from the company's public web presence.

providers.name: GNC Holdings
providers.description: GNC Holdings, LLC (General Nutrition Centers) is an American specialty retailer of health, wellness, and performance products including vitamins, minerals, herbal supplements, sports nutrition, diet, and energy products. Founded in 1935 and headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, GNC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Harbin Pharmaceutical Group following its 2020 acquisition. The company operates owned and franchised retail locations, online stores, and retail partnerships across approximately 50 countries.

providers.name: Kindred Healthcare
providers.description: Kindred Healthcare operated a nationwide network of long-term acute care hospitals and inpatient rehabilitation facilities. The Kindred name was retired after the 2021 merger with LifePoint Health, with the acute care facilities operating under the ScionHealth brand and rehabilitation facilities continuing as Kindred Hospital Rehabilitation Services. No public REST APIs or developer portal have been identified for the legacy Kindred Healthcare or its successor entities.

providers.name: QuSecure
providers.description: QuSecure is a post-quantum cybersecurity company whose QuProtect R3 platform helps enterprises and government agencies discover, remediate, and report on cryptographic risk ahead of the quantum-computing threat. The platform pairs Recon (automated inventory of cryptographic assets), Resilience (crypto-agile remediation of encryption without code changes or downtime), and Reporting (Cryptographic Bill of Materials / CBOM for NIST, FIPS, CNSA 2.0, and GDPR compliance). QuSecure serves telecom, defense, finance, and critical-infrastructure customers including Fortune 500 companies and U.S. federal agencies. This profile currently exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: R1 RCM
providers.description: R1 RCM is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The R1 RCM API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: The Estée Lauder Companies
providers.description: The Estée Lauder Companies Inc. (NYSE: EL) is one of the world's leading manufacturers, marketers and sellers of quality prestige skin care, makeup, fragrance and hair care products. Founded in 1946 by Estée and Joseph Lauder, the family-controlled, New York-headquartered conglomerate operates a portfolio of more than 20 prestige brands sold in approximately 150 countries and territories, employs roughly 57,000 people worldwide, and reported fiscal 2025 net sales of approximately $14.32 billion. ELC's corporate website (elcompanies.com) does not expose any public developer APIs, OpenAPI specs, SDKs, sandboxes, or a developer portal — the EsteeLauder GitHub organization is empty of public repositories. The technology surface is instead expressed through enterprise partnerships: the AI Innovation Lab (announced 2023, expanded April 2024) jointly run with Microsoft on Azure OpenAI Service; the ConsumerIQ tool built on Microsoft Copilot Studio (2025); an Adobe Firefly Services generative AI collaboration for digital marketing assets (March 2025); a Google Gemini / Vertex AI–powered Jo Malone London Scent Advisor (December 2025); and a Shopify-based unified global direct-to-consumer commerce platform (announced October 2025, ~50% rolled out by calendar year-end 2026). ELC's strategic vision, "Beauty Reimagined" (announced February 2025), and the Profit Recovery and Growth Plan ($0.8–1.0B gross benefits; $1.2–1.6B restructuring charges) anchor the One ELC operating model now led by CEO Stéphane de La Faverie and Board Chair William P. Lauder.

Agilon Health does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: Concentrix

Its product suite spans the iX product line (including iX Hello and iX Hero agentic AI assistants) and the Catalyst experience transformation and technology consultancy. Concentrix does not publish a public developer API; the iX product suite and Catalyst services are delivered via managed engagements and enterprise integrations rather than a self-service developer portal.

providers.name: SCANA Corporation
providers.description: SCANA Corporation was an American regulated electric and natural gas public utility headquartered in Cayce, South Carolina. Its primary subsidiaries included South Carolina Electric & Gas (SCE&G), which provided electric and natural gas service to approximately 660,000 electric customers in South Carolina, and PSNC Energy, which served over one million natural gas customers in North Carolina and Georgia. SCANA was acquired by Dominion Energy in January 2019, after which the SCANA, SCE&G, and PSNC names were retired and operations were integrated into Dominion Energy's Southeast Energy Group. SCANA Energy Natural Gas continues to operate as a retail natural gas marketer in Georgia.

providers.name: Sirius XM Holdings
providers.description: Sirius XM Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: SIRI) is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, operating a portfolio of subscription, ad-supported streaming, podcast, and advertising-technology businesses. Its flagship satellite radio service SiriusXM serves roughly 33 million paid subscribers, while Pandora delivers ad-supported and premium music streaming to approximately 40 million active users. The portfolio also includes podcast network Simplecast, programmatic audio adtech platform AdsWizz, audio sales arm SiriusXM Media, and Pandora AMP. SiriusXM Holdings was split off from Liberty Media in September 2024, becoming an independent publicly traded company. This holdings-level index points to the operating subsidiaries; the consolidated developer surface is profiled in the `sirius-xm` repository, with no separate corporate developer program at the holding-company level.

providers.name: Agl Resources
providers.description: AGL Resources was an energy services holding company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, whose principal business was the distribution of natural gas to residential, commercial, and industrial customers. In 2016, AGL Resources was acquired by Southern Company and renamed Southern Company Gas, becoming the nation's largest natural gas-only distribution company. The company distributes natural gas through subsidiaries including Atlanta Gas Light, Chattanooga Gas, Nicor Gas, and Virginia Natural Gas. AGL Resources / Southern Company Gas does not offer a public developer API; utility data access is available through third-party data aggregators and community-built integrations.

providers.name: Dana Incorporated
providers.description: Dana Incorporated is a global supplier of fully integrated drivetrain and electrified propulsion systems for passenger, commercial, and off-highway vehicles. Dana announced an agreement in 2025 for its Off-Highway business to be acquired by Allison Transmission. Dana's main public API surface is the Dana Aftermarket developer platform; this repository is an alias of the primary "dana" profile.

providers.name: Hesi
providers.description: Hesi (合思, operated by Beijing Hosi Information Technology Co., Ltd.) is an AI-driven spend and expense management SaaS platform founded in 2014 and backed by the SoftBank Vision Fund. Its cloud platform covers intelligent expense control and reimbursement ("no expense reports needed"), corporate business-travel booking, AI-powered audit and approval, electronic accounting archives, accounts payable/receivable, and business-intelligence analytics. Hesi serves 7,000+ paid enterprises — including large corporations and Fortune 500 firms across China — and runs a PaaS platform with integrations to roughly 1,400 banks. The company operates R&D centers in Beijing, Hangzhou, and Nanchang with 22 direct service offices nationwide.

providers.name: Rivian Automotive
providers.description: Rivian Automotive is an American electric vehicle manufacturer that designs and builds adventure-oriented electric trucks, SUVs, and commercial delivery vans, along with the charging infrastructure and connected-vehicle software that supports them. While Rivian does not publish a public developer API portal, an unofficial GraphQL API powers the Rivian mobile app and has been reverse-engineered by community projects for vehicle telemetry and control.

Cinemark does not currently publish a general-purpose public developer portal; ticketing, showtime, and loyalty integrations are typically delivered through partner agreements and third-party aggregators (Movio, Atom Tickets, Fandango).

Corteva was formed as the spinoff of the agriculture division of DowDuPont in June 2019. The company markets seeds under the Pioneer, Brevant, and other brands and crop protection products including herbicides, fungicides, insecticides, and biologicals. Corteva also operates Granular, a farm management software platform with insights and analytics products. A public developer API is not currently published; growers access tools through the Granular Insights and Granular Link platforms.

providers.description: Fox Corporation (NASDAQ: FOXA, FOX) is a US media company spun out of 21st Century Fox in 2019 when the rest of the business was sold to Disney. Per the company website, "Fox Corporation produces and distributes compelling news, sports, and entertainment content through its primary iconic domestic brands" — Fox News Media (Fox News Channel, Fox Business Network, Fox News Digital, Fox News Audio, Fox Weather), Fox Sports (FS1, FS2, Big Ten Network, Fox Deportes, Fox Bet partnerships), Fox Entertainment, Fox Television Stations, and the Tubi Media Group (Tubi free ad-supported streaming, Credible). In May 2024 Fox acquired Mexican sports-betting and casino operator Caliente.mx, expanding its sports-and-wagering footprint into Latin America. Fox does not publish a public developer portal or REST API surface for the parent corporation — programmatic distribution is delivered via per-brand RSS / Atom feeds (Fox News, Fox Business, Fox Sports, Fox Weather), the Tubi Media Group open source projects on GitHub (github.com/Tubitv, 53 public repositories), and direct B2B advertising and content-syndication relationships rather than self-serve API signup. This apis.yml therefore catalogs the public RSS surface, Tubi engineering OSS, and the corporate/brand web properties.

TrueBlue's digital platforms include JobStack for on-demand industrial staffing and Affinix for recruitment process outsourcing.

No public developer API has been identified; Welltower primarily uses internal proprietary systems for property management and operator coordination.

In July 2022, Whiting Petroleum merged with Oasis Petroleum to form Chord Energy Corporation, which trades on NASDAQ under the ticker symbol CHRD.

providers.name: Berkshire Hathaway
providers.description: Berkshire Hathaway is a multinational conglomerate holding company headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska. The company's diversified subsidiaries span insurance (GEICO, Berkshire Hathaway Specialty Insurance, National Indemnity), freight rail transportation (BNSF Railway), utilities and energy (Berkshire Hathaway Energy), manufacturing (Precision Castparts, Iscar), wholesale distribution (McLane Company), and services and retailing. BNSF Railway, one of North America's largest freight rail networks, operates a public API Center providing customer APIs for shipment tracking, pricing, scheduling, and waybill management.

Founded in 1956 and headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska, Werner operates one of the largest fleets in the United States and offers freight brokerage, dedicated carriage, intermodal, and final-mile delivery services through its Werner Bridge℠ digital freight platform.

providers.name: Bug Labs
providers.description: Bug Labs is a New York City enterprise software company founded in 2006, first as one of the earliest open-source modular hardware makers and later as an enterprise IoT platform provider serving Fortune 500 customers including Verizon, Comcast, VMware, Ford, Charter and Orange. Its current flagship product, Signalpattern, targets workflow fragmentation by mapping and connecting dispersed enterprise systems, automating cross-system tasks, and letting users interact with APIs directly without writing code. Bug Labs previously operated the well-known public IoT APIs dweet.io, dweetpro.io and freeboard.io; all three are decommissioned and the company publishes no developer portal, API documentation or public API today. Backed by Union Square Ventures, Spark Capital and Court Square Ventures.

providers.name: Dollar Tree
providers.description: Dollar Tree is a leading operator of discount variety stores in North America, operating more than 16,000 stores under the Dollar Tree and Family Dollar banners. Vendor and supplier integration is primarily handled through EDI, SAP, and ERP systems via the Dollar Tree Vendor Portal. No public REST API is currently available.

providers.name: Linde
providers.description: Linde is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Linde API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Moog
providers.description: Moog Inc. is a worldwide designer, manufacturer, and integrator of precision motion and fluid control products and solutions for aerospace, defense, industrial, and medical applications. Product divisions include actuation, motion systems, motors, propulsion, valves, aerospace components, and defense systems. Moog does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal.
