providers.name: American Water Works
providers.description: American Water Works Company is the largest publicly traded U.S. water and wastewater utility company, providing drinking water, wastewater, and other related services to approximately 14 million people in more than 1,700 communities across 14 states. The company operates through regulated utility subsidiaries and offers customer self-service through its MyWater online portal and mobile app.

providers.name: ConocoPhillips
providers.description: ConocoPhillips is a leading global exploration and production company, headquartered in Houston, Texas, that is uniquely equipped to deliver reliable, responsibly produced oil and natural gas. The company operates in more than a dozen countries with conventional and unconventional crude oil, natural gas, LNG, and natural gas liquids assets. ConocoPhillips does not publish public developer APIs; its external digital surface is organized around an investor relations portal, a vendor relations portal (powered by third-party platforms such as GEP and Taulia), an LNG technology and licensing program, and a custom sustainability report builder.

providers.name: Universal Corporation
providers.description: Universal Corporation is a global leaf tobacco merchant and processor that selects, buys, processes, packs, stores, ships, and finances leaf tobacco for sale to manufacturers of consumer tobacco products. Operating in approximately 30 countries, Universal Corporation is the world's leading supplier of leaf tobacco, providing supply chain management, processing, and blending services. The company has developed digital platforms including MobiLeaf, a tablet-based grower management system for tobacco farmer support and crop tracking.

providers.name: Centric Brands
providers.description: Centric Brands LLC is a New York-headquartered global lifestyle brand management and product-development platform formed in October 2018 when Differential Brands Group (NASDAQ: DFBG) acquired Global Brands Group's $1.2B North American licensing business. The company designs, sources, markets, and distributes apparel, accessories, footwear, beauty, and entertainment-licensed products across men's, women's, kids', accessories, and entertainment segments. Its mission is "to be a leading global apparel & accessories company with a portfolio of iconic licensed and owned brands that delight retailers and consumers of all ages." Centric filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy on May 18, 2020 and emerged in October 2020 under control of secured creditors led by Blackstone's GSO Capital Partners, Ares Management, and HPS Investment Partners. The company is led by CEO Jason Rabin (since 2018) and operates ~20 global offices across New York (HQ), Los Angeles, Greensboro, Montreal, London, Amsterdam, Hong Kong, and multiple cities in China, Bangladesh, Cambodia, India, and Vietnam. Owned brands include Hudson Jeans, Buffalo Jeans, Robert Graham, Joe's Jeans, Hervé Léger, Favorite Daughter, and AllSaints; licensed apparel brands include Calvin Klein, Tommy Hilfiger, Nautica, Spyder, IZOD, Van Heusen, Kate Spade New York, Coach, Michael Kors, Frye, Timberland, Lucky Brand, Juicy Couture, Under Armour, and Off-White; the entertainment licensing portfolio spans 70+ properties including Disney, Marvel, Warner Bros., DC, Nintendo, Hasbro, Mattel, Nickelodeon, Netflix, Pokémon, Sanrio, Paw Patrol, and the NFL/MLB/NBA/NHL via Sports & Entertainment Licensing. Centric Brands operates "11 end-to-end Ecommerce sites," a 3D design and art studio in Greensboro, and a New York City photo/video studio. The company has no public developer program, no documented public APIs, and no public source code repositories; its two namesake GitHub organizations (centric-brands, Centricbrands) are private placeholders with zero public repos.

providers.name: Western & Southern Financial Group
providers.description: Western & Southern Financial Group is a Fortune 500 diversified family of financial services companies headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio. Founded in 1888, the group offers life insurance, annuities, mutual funds, asset management, retirement planning, and investment management through a family of subsidiaries including Western & Southern Life, Columbus Life, Gerber Life, Integrity Life, Lafayette Life, Fort Washington Investment Advisors, Touchstone Investments, and W&S Financial Group Distributors, with over $112 billion in assets under management.

providers.name: United Continental Holdings
providers.description: United Continental Holdings, now known as United Airlines Holdings, Inc., is the parent holding company of United Airlines. It was formed through the merger of United Airlines and Continental Airlines in 2010. As the parent company, it oversees United Airlines' operations, which include one of the world's largest airline route networks. The company's APIs and digital services are delivered through United Airlines.

providers.name: Cracker Barrel Old Country Store
providers.description: Cracker Barrel Old Country Store, Inc. is an American chain of restaurants and gift shops with a Southern country theme, offering home-style meals and retail merchandise. Founded in 1969 and headquartered in Lebanon, Tennessee, Cracker Barrel operates roughly 656 restaurant and retail locations across 44 U.S. states. No public API or developer portal is published; the company offers a consumer website, iOS and Android mobile ordering apps, To-Go and catering ordering, gift cards, and the Cracker Barrel Rewards loyalty program for guests.

providers.name: Elementary
providers.description: Elementary is an AI-powered machine-vision inspection company for manufacturing, founded in 2017 in South Pasadena, California (originally Elementary Robotics). Its VisionStream self-training edge AI detects production defects in seconds without rules, labeling, or tuning, while the QualityOS cloud platform delivers traceability, analytics, and MES/ERP integration across production lines. Elementary inspects over one billion parts annually for Fortune 500 manufacturers across food & beverage, automotive, consumer packaged goods, electronics, and life sciences, and is backed by Rockwell Automation, Tiger Global, Toyota Ventures, Threshold Ventures, Fika Ventures, and Idealab. The company exposes no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, security posture, and public web properties.

providers.name: Globe Life
providers.description: Globe Life is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Globe Life API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Topgolf Callaway Brands
providers.description: Topgolf Callaway Brands is a global golf and entertainment company that designs, manufactures, and sells golf clubs, balls, apparel, and accessories under the Callaway, Odyssey, OGIO, TravisMathew, and Jack Wolfskin brands, and operates Topgolf entertainment venues and the Toptracer ball-tracking technology. Topgolf Callaway Brands does not publish a single public developer API portal, though Toptracer ball-tracking technology is licensed to driving ranges through a separate commercial program.

providers.name: Westar Energy
providers.description: Westar Energy was the largest electric utility in Kansas, providing electric service to homes, businesses, and industries throughout Kansas before merging with Great Plains Energy in 2018 to form Evergy, Inc. As Evergy, the company continues to serve approximately 1.6 million customers in Kansas and Missouri with a focus on grid modernization, smart metering (AMI) through its Gridstream Connect IoT platform, and clean energy transformation including wind power and demand response programs.

providers.name: Carter's
providers.description: Carter's is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Carter's API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Delek US
providers.description: Delek US is an alias for Delek US Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: DK), a diversified downstream energy company headquartered in Brentwood, Tennessee with assets in petroleum refining, logistics, asphalt operations, renewable fuels, and convenience store retailing. Delek operates four refineries in Tyler and Big Spring (Texas), El Dorado (Arkansas), and Krotz Springs (Louisiana) with combined crude throughput capacity of roughly 302,000 barrels per day. The canonical profile for this company is maintained under aid delek-us-holdings; this entry exists as a name alias and references the corporate site. Delek does not publish a developer API; partner integrations occur through industry-standard EDI, terminal automation, and ticketing systems.

providers.name: Ducommun
providers.description: Ducommun is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Ducommun API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Gatik
providers.description: Gatik is an autonomous trucking company founded in 2017 by Gautam Narang, Arjun Narang and Apeksha Kumavat, headquartered in Silicon Valley, California. Gatik builds and operates the Gatik Driver, an SAE Level 4 autonomy system purpose-built for the middle mile: short-haul, repeatable freight routes between distribution centers, dark stores and retail endpoints. Gatik runs driverless medium-duty box trucks in commercial service for Fortune 50 retailers and grocers including Walmart, Loblaw, Kroger, Tyson Foods, Pitney Bowes and PepsiCo, across Texas, Arkansas, Arizona, Ontario and other North American markets. The company partners with Isuzu, Ryder, Goodyear and NVIDIA, runs the Gatik Arena simulation platform, and publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK or developer portal — its surface is a corporate marketing site plus a legacy archive site carrying about, safety, news, careers and legal pages.

Barnes & Noble also operates the Nook e-reader platform and offers affiliate and publisher partner programs. No public developer API is currently offered; the company operates primarily through retail channels and affiliate marketing programs.

providers.name: Cameron International
providers.description: Cameron International (formerly Cooper Cameron Corporation) was a leading provider of flow equipment products, systems, and services to the worldwide oil, gas, and process industries. In 2016 the business was acquired by Schlumberger (now SLB) and its pressure-control, drilling, subsea, valves, measurement, and compression product lines were integrated into SLB's digital oilfield portfolio. Cameron-branded capabilities are now delivered and integrated through the SLB DELFI digital platform and its developer APIs rather than through a standalone Cameron developer program.

providers.name: Silgan Holdings
providers.description: Silgan Holdings Inc. is a leading global sustainable packaging provider for consumer goods products. The company partners with customers to deliver essential products to the world in efficient, sustainable, and cost-effective packaging formats. Silgan operates through three primary business segments: Dispensing and Specialty Closures, Metal Containers, and Custom Containers. With 123 manufacturing facilities on four continents, over 17,200 employees, and approximately $6 billion in annual sales, Silgan serves the food, beverage, healthcare, home and garden, personal care, fragrance, and beauty end markets.

providers.name: Thor Industries
providers.description: Thor Industries is the world's largest manufacturer of recreational vehicles, owning subsidiary brands including Airstream, Jayco, Heartland RV, Keystone RV, and others. Thor Industries operates primarily as a manufacturing company and does not publish a public developer API. Dealer integrations and connected vehicle features are managed through subsidiary brands and OEM partnerships.

The company supports customers through technical product resources such as its Alloy Finder, alloy technical data sheets, conversion tables, and a member-only Customer Portal for order and account self-service, but does not currently publish a public developer API.

The company focuses on rehabilitation services for stroke, neurological conditions, spinal cord injuries, and orthopedic conditions. No public developer APIs have been identified.

providers.name: Range Resources
providers.description: Range Resources is an independent natural gas, natural gas liquids, and oil company engaged in the exploration, development, and acquisition of natural gas and oil properties primarily in the Appalachian region. Range does not publish a public developer API; this index tracks the company's public-facing digital properties for reference.

providers.name: American Equity Investment Life Holding
providers.description: American Equity Investment Life Holding Company is a leading provider of guaranteed income solutions, specializing in the design, development, and sale of fixed indexed and fixed-rate annuity products distributed through independent agents and broker-dealers. The company offers products including IncomeShield, AssetShield, EstateShield, and GuaranteeShield annuities, providing retirees with lifetime income, principal protection, tax-deferred growth, and legacy planning options.

providers.name: Cincinnati Financial
providers.description: Cincinnati Financial Corporation (NASDAQ: CINF) is a property and casualty insurer headquartered in Fairfield, Ohio, that markets a full suite of business, home, auto, and life insurance products plus investment services exclusively through a network of independent insurance agencies. Cincinnati Financial does not currently operate a public developer portal or expose customer-facing APIs; agency, claims, and policyholder access is delivered through web portals (cinfin.com, onlineservice.cinfin.com, and the Cincinnati Insurance Mobile App), with technical integrations for appointed agencies handled directly by Cincinnati Insurance IT support.

providers.name: DNOW
providers.description: DNOW Inc. (NYSE: DNOW), formerly NOW Inc. and operating as DistributionNOW, is a Houston-headquartered Fortune 1000 distributor of pipe, valves, fittings (PVF), pumps and packaged, engineered process and production equipment serving the upstream, midstream, downstream energy, and industrial sectors. Spun off from National Oilwell Varco in 2014 and built on a heritage that spans more than 160 years, DNOW combines a global network of distribution branches and engineering facilities with the DigitalNOW platform — shop.dnow.com B2B eCommerce, cXML/OCI ERP punchout integrations, the eSpec product configurator, the AccessNOW automated inventory control system, and a library of customer-facing mobile applications. DNOW does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, or a self-serve API program; customer integrations are delivered through configured cXML/OCI punchout sessions tied to enterprise ERP systems. In June 2025 DNOW announced a definitive merger agreement to acquire MRC Global in an all-stock transaction valued at approximately $1.5 billion.

providers.name: Coterra Energy

providers.name: EMCOR Group
providers.description: EMCOR Group is a Fortune 500 mechanical and electrical construction, energy, and facilities services company headquartered in Norwalk, Connecticut. It operates through three segments, EMCOR Construction Services, EMCOR Building Services, and EMCOR Industrial Services, delivering hyperscale data center construction, hospital support services, energy efficiency programs, and green building solutions. This repository captures the public APIs, developer resources, and machine-readable artifacts associated with EMCOR Group.

providers.name: T. Rowe Price
providers.description: T. Rowe Price is a global asset management firm (NYSE: TROW) offering a broad range of investment management strategies and retirement solutions to individuals, advisors, institutions, and retirement plan sponsors. Founded in 1937, the firm manages mutual funds, ETFs, separate accounts, and retirement plans including 401(k) services. T. Rowe Price does not offer a public REST API but provides institutional client portals, data feeds, and integrations with retirement recordkeeping platforms and open banking aggregators such as Plaid and Finicity.

providers.name: Booz Allen Hamilton
providers.description: Booz Allen Hamilton is a leading management and technology consulting firm providing services primarily to U.S. government agencies in defense, intelligence, and civil markets. The firm employs over 2,500 AI specialists and 8,000 cybersecurity professionals, and maintains a significant open source presence on GitHub with projects including the Solutions Delivery Platform, Open Data Platform, and Cognition data fusion platform.

providers.name: Cornerstone Building Brands
providers.description: Cornerstone Building Brands is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Cornerstone Building Brands API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Smartsign
providers.description: Smartsign (SmartSign) is a Brooklyn, New York-based e-commerce retailer of customizable signs, labels, and tags for regulatory, compliance, and safety applications, founded in 1999. It sells pre-designed and custom signage - safety, parking, traffic, property, and facility signs, plus banners and labels - online to businesses of all sizes, including a large share of the Fortune 1000 across education, healthcare, and industrial verticals. Norwest Venture Partners acquired the company in 2019 and Sentinel Capital Partners acquired it in September 2022. SmartSign operates as a business-to-business and business-to-consumer e-commerce storefront and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Bio-Rad Laboratories
providers.description: Bio-Rad Laboratories is a global leader in developing and manufacturing a wide range of products for the life science research and clinical diagnostic markets, including instruments, reagents, consumables, software, and services. Founded in 1952, Bio-Rad serves scientists in genomics, proteomics, cell biology, quality control, and clinical diagnostics with products like real-time PCR systems, western blotting instruments, flow cytometers, and digital PCR.

providers.name: Diebold Nixdorf
providers.description: Diebold Nixdorf is a global leader in driving connected commerce for the financial and retail industries, providing self-service kiosks, ATMs, point-of-sale systems, Vynamic software, and related services. While Diebold Nixdorf operates several customer support and software portals (Aftersales Portal, eServices Portal, Manuals Drivers and Downloads), it does not currently publish a public open developer portal or open APIs. This repository is maintained as a placeholder for any APIs, developer tools, or machine-readable artifacts that may emerge.

providers.name: Williams Companies
providers.description: The Williams Companies is an American Fortune 500 energy company focused on natural gas infrastructure, processing, and transportation. Williams owns and operates midstream energy assets including the Transco pipeline (the largest natural gas pipeline in the United States), gathering and processing systems, and storage facilities. Williams serves natural gas producers, local distribution companies, and large-volume end users. The company provides customer portal access for operational data and FERC-regulated electronic bulletin boards for capacity transactions, but does not offer public developer REST APIs.

providers.name: ARKO Corp
providers.description: ARKO Corp (Nasdaq: ARKO) is a Fortune 500 company and one of the largest operators of convenience stores and wholesalers of fuel in the United States. Through its subsidiary GPM Investments, ARKO operates approximately 1,400 company-operated stores under 25+ regional brands across 30+ states, as well as proprietary cardlock locations and a fleet fueling network. In 2026, ARKO completed the IPO of ARKO Petroleum Corp., which operates its wholesale, fleet fueling, and petroleum distribution segments.

providers.name: HUB Group
providers.description: HUB is a global leader in multifunction pole design and street infrastructure, supplying over 1,000 pieces of urban infrastructure worldwide. With 20+ years of experience, HUB excels in integrating digital devices and data analytics into innovative urban solutions. Partnered with Valmont Industries, HUB delivers high-quality infrastructure for public spaces, including telecommunications poles, monopoles, steel jackets, and head frames.

providers.name: Sonic Automotive
providers.description: Sonic Automotive is one of the largest automotive retailers in the United States, operating 100+ franchise dealerships across 13 states representing 25+ automotive brands, and operating EchoPark Automotive used-vehicle stores. The company invests in digital retail, inventory management technology, and automotive data platforms to enhance customer experience across vehicle sales, service, finance, and insurance. Technology partners include Stripe, NETSOL, and CDK Global.

providers.name: VF Corporation
providers.description: VF Corporation is a global apparel and footwear company headquartered in Denver, Colorado. VF owns major brands including Vans, The North Face, Timberland, Altra, Eastpak, Icebreaker, JanSport, Kipling, Napapijri, and Smartwool. The company does not offer a public developer API program; its technology integrations are handled through third-party e-commerce platforms and enterprise supply chain systems. VF Corporation operates more than 1,500 stores globally and integrates with platforms such as Shopify, Amazon, Magento, WooCommerce, and BigCommerce via third-party integration services.

providers.name: American Family Insurance
providers.description: American Family Insurance is a private mutual company that offers auto, homeowners, life, renters, umbrella, business, and farm/ranch insurance throughout the United States. The company serves customers through a network of exclusive agents, digital tools including the MyAmFam mobile app, and online self-service capabilities. American Family is headquartered in Madison, Wisconsin, and is one of the largest property-casualty insurers in the country.

providers.name: Core-Mark Holding
providers.description: Core-Mark Holding Company, a subsidiary of Performance Food Group, is one of the largest broad-line, full-service marketers and distributors of packaged consumer products to the convenience retail industry in North America. The company serves more than 41,000 retail locations across the United States and Canada, supplying tobacco, candy, snacks, beverages, foodservice, and other fast-moving consumer goods. Core-Mark provides retailer technology platforms including Core-Source Portal, Retailer Analytics, Core-Mark Ordering, and Core-Mark Intellisite.

providers.name: Costco Wholesale
providers.description: Costco Wholesale Corporation is a Fortune 500 American multinational membership-only big-box retail chain that operates warehouse clubs offering a wide selection of merchandise at discounted prices. Costco does not publish a public developer API; supplier and trading partner integrations are conducted through EDI and B2B channels using ANSI X12 transactions and the Costco Supplier Portal. Costco operates an e-commerce site, the Costco Travel and Costco Pharmacy properties, and the Costco Photo Center.

providers.name: Exxon Mobil
providers.description: Exxon Mobil Corporation is one of the world's largest publicly traded international energy companies, exploring for, producing, and refining oil and natural gas and manufacturing petroleum and chemical products. This repository tracks any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts associated with Exxon Mobil.

providers.name: HCA Holdings
providers.description: HCA Holdings is an alias for HCA Healthcare, one of the largest for-profit operators of healthcare facilities in the world, operating hospitals, surgery centers, freestanding emergency rooms, and urgent care centers. The legal entity rebranded to HCA Healthcare; this index tracks the legacy name. No public developer portal or production APIs are advertised.

providers.name: Healthpeak Properties
providers.description: Healthpeak Properties (NYSE: DOC) is an S&P 500 healthcare real estate investment trust (REIT) that owns, operates, and develops real estate for healthcare discovery and outpatient care — concentrated in lab/life-sciences, outpatient medical, and continuing care retirement community (CCRC) senior housing segments. The company tagline is "Where Discovery and Outpatient Care Thrive." Originally founded as HCP Inc. in 1985, the company rebranded to Healthpeak Properties in 2019. On March 1, 2024, Healthpeak completed an all-stock merger of equals with Physicians Realty Trust, combining two of the largest outpatient medical real estate platforms in the United States and adopting the new NYSE ticker DOC (previously PEAK). Healthpeak's portfolio spans roughly 700 properties nationwide, with lab concentrations in the South San Francisco, Boston, and San Diego clusters (including Torrey Pines Science Park and The Cove at Oyster Point) and outpatient medical assets clustered on or near top-ranked hospital campuses such as Medical City Dallas. The company reports that approximately 150,000 scientists, researchers, physicians, and healthcare professionals work in its buildings. As a healthcare REIT, Healthpeak does not publish a public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, or technical integration surface. Its public digital footprint is limited to corporate marketing, an investor relations site, SEC filings, ESG/sustainability reporting, and a press room. Tenant-facing operational systems (work orders, building access, energy reporting) are not exposed externally.

providers.name: Iron Mountain
providers.description: Iron Mountain is a global leader in storage and information management services, providing records management, data centers, secure shredding, digital transformation, and asset lifecycle management for organizations worldwide. Iron Mountain helps customers protect and unlock value from their physical and digital information assets.

providers.name: McKesson
providers.description: McKesson is a Fortune 500 healthcare company providing wholesale medical supplies and equipment, pharmaceutical distribution, and healthcare technology solutions. No public developer APIs are currently documented.

providers.name: Sanderson Farms
providers.description: Sanderson Farms was the third-largest poultry producer in the United States, producing over 13 million chickens per week before being acquired by a joint venture of Cargill and Continental Grain in 2022 to form Wayne-Sanderson Farms. Headquartered in Laurel, Mississippi, the company operated processing facilities across the southeastern United States and was a Fortune 1000 company. As a large-scale agricultural and food production enterprise, Sanderson Farms does not offer public developer APIs. The company focused on poultry processing, supply chain management, and food safety operations.

providers.name: American Eagle Outfitters
providers.description: American Eagle Outfitters (AEO) is a global specialty retailer operating the American Eagle and Aerie brands, offering on-trend clothing, accessories, and personal care products at affordable prices. The company operates over 1,000 stores across the Americas and online, with a unified commerce strategy spanning e-commerce, mobile, and in-store experiences.

providers.name: American Electric Power
providers.description: American Electric Power (AEP) is one of the largest electric utilities in the United States, delivering electricity to more than 5.6 million customers across 11 states through its regulated utility subsidiaries including AEP Ohio, AEP Texas, Appalachian Power, Indiana Michigan Power, Kentucky Power, Public Service Company of Oklahoma, and Southwestern Electric Power Company. AEP operates the nation's largest electricity transmission network spanning over 40,000 miles and maintains approximately 31,000 megawatts of generating capacity.

providers.name: Anadarko Petroleum
providers.description: Anadarko Petroleum Corporation was one of the world's largest independent oil and natural gas exploration and production companies, with operations across the United States, the deepwater Gulf of Mexico, and international locations including Mozambique and Ghana. Anadarko was acquired by Occidental Petroleum in August 2019 in a $55 billion transaction. The company was known for its operations in the Wattenberg Gas Field in Colorado, the Delaware Basin in Texas, and major deepwater projects. Anadarko did not offer public developer APIs; its technology integrations were primarily through enterprise systems for partners and joint venture operators.

providers.name: Domtar
providers.description: Domtar is committed to turning responsibly sourced wood fiber into essential products like paper, pulp, recycled packaging, tissue, and lumber. No public developer-facing APIs have been identified at this time; this index will be updated if any are made available.

providers.name: Peter Kiewit Sons'
providers.description: Peter Kiewit Sons' (Kiewit Corporation) is one of North America's largest and most respected construction and engineering organizations, working on projects in transportation, water, oil, gas, power, and building markets. This repository tracks any publicly available APIs, SDKs, and developer resources for Kiewit.

providers.name: Raytheon
providers.description: Raytheon is an American aerospace and defense manufacturer operating as a business of RTX Corporation, the world's largest aerospace and defense company. Raytheon designs, develops, and produces advanced defense systems including precision weapons, air and missile defense systems, sensors, radar, electronic warfare, command-and-control solutions, and cyber capabilities for the U.S. military and allied governments worldwide. Key products include the Patriot missile defense system, StormBreaker smart weapons, RAIVEN electro-optical/infrared sensor suites, and advanced electronic attack systems. Raytheon also develops world-class logistics software through the EAGLE team supporting production management, technical manual development, and product support data. No public developer API or machine-readable specification is available at this time; Raytheon's software solutions are deployed within government program contracts.

providers.name: Cabot Oil & Gas
providers.description: Cabot Oil & Gas was an independent oil and gas company engaged in the development, exploitation, exploration, production, and marketing of natural gas and oil properties in the United States. In 2021 it merged with Cimarex Energy to form Coterra Energy, which operates across the Permian Basin, Marcellus Shale, and Anadarko Basin.

providers.name: Armstrong World Industries
providers.description: Armstrong World Industries (NYSE: AWI) is a leading global designer and manufacturer of innovative commercial and residential ceiling, wall, and suspension system solutions. Armstrong offers a broad portfolio of ceiling and wall products across mineral fiber, fiberglass, wood, metal, and specialty substrates for use in commercial construction and renovation projects worldwide. The company provides BIM content, product data, and specification tools for architects and designers but does not offer a public developer API.

providers.name: Brinker International
providers.description: Brinker International is a leading casual dining restaurant company that owns, operates, and franchises Chili's Grill & Bar and Maggiano's Little Italy. Headquartered in Dallas, Texas, Brinker operates over 1,600 Chili's locations across 29 countries and over 50 Maggiano's locations in the United States. The company leverages digital ordering platforms, loyalty programs, mobile apps, in-restaurant kiosks, and point-of-sale integrations for restaurant operations, running a unified open-source e-commerce environment built on Red Hat (RHEL, Satellite, Lightspeed) and using Prismic CMS for digital content management. Brinker operates an SSO-gated partner/franchise API developer portal at developer.brinker.com for onboarding partners; there is no public, self-service developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or open GitHub organization. Consumer-facing surfaces are the Chili's and Maggiano's mobile apps and websites and their loyalty programs.

providers.name: CSX Corporation
providers.description: CSX Corporation is a Class I freight railroad operating one of the largest rail networks in the eastern United States, serving 23 states with roughly 20,000 route miles of track. CSX moves bulk commodities, intermodal shipments, and merchandise for industrial customers and operates the ShipCSX customer portal for shipment management, EDI integration, and freight tracking.

providers.name: General Electric
providers.description: General Electric Company has reorganized into separate publicly traded companies: GE Aerospace, focused on jet engines and aviation systems, and GE Vernova, focused on energy and power generation. GE HealthCare was spun off in 2023. No unified public developer API portal is currently published by GE Aerospace or GE Vernova.

providers.name: Keurig Dr Pepper
providers.description: Keurig Dr Pepper is a leading North American beverage company formed by the 2018 merger of Keurig Green Mountain and Dr Pepper Snapple Group. It operates a portfolio of more than 125 owned, licensed, partner, and allied brands across hot and cold beverages, including Keurig single-serve brewing systems and brands such as Dr Pepper, 7UP, Snapple, Mott's, Bai, Green Mountain Coffee Roasters, and Peet's Coffee.

providers.name: PerkinElmer
providers.description: PerkinElmer is a global leader in scientific instrumentation, lab services, and informatics for life sciences, diagnostics, food, environmental, and industrial markets. The company provides analytical instruments, reagents, software, and software downloads to support laboratory operations and scientific research.

providers.name: Realogy Holdings
providers.description: Realogy Holdings (now Anywhere Real Estate) is a global provider of residential real estate services with brands including Better Homes and Gardens Real Estate, Century 21, Coldwell Banker, Corcoran, ERA, and Sotheby's International Realty. Realogy Holdings does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; integrations are managed through brand-specific technology platforms and partner programs.

providers.name: Sonoco Products
providers.description: Sonoco Products Company is a global leader in sustainable metal and fiber consumer and industrial packaging, operating 285 facilities across 40 countries with 23,000+ employees. Products include metal packaging (aerosol cans, steel food cans, closures), rigid paper packaging (paper containers, fiber cartridges), industrial paper packaging (tubes, cores, recycled paperboard), and industrial specialty packaging (plastic components, reels, spools). Serves food and beverage, pet care, household products, beauty, automotive, and industrial markets. A Fortune 500 company (NYSE: SON).

providers.name: Western Refining
providers.description: Western Refining was an independent crude oil refiner and marketer of refined petroleum products headquartered in El Paso, Texas. The company operated refineries in El Paso, Texas; Gallup, New Mexico; and St. Paul Park, Minnesota before being acquired by Tesoro Corporation in 2017 for approximately $6.4 billion. Western Refining's assets are now part of Andeavor (formerly Tesoro), subsequently acquired by Marathon Petroleum in 2018.

providers.name: Avery Dennison
providers.description: Avery Dennison is a global materials science and manufacturing company specializing in the design and manufacture of labeling and functional materials, packaging, and intelligent labels.

providers.name: Avis Budget
providers.description: Avis Budget Group is a leading global provider of vehicle rental and mobility solutions with brands including Avis, Budget, Budget Truck, Payless, and Zipcar.

providers.name: Avnet
providers.description: Avnet is a global technology distributor and solutions provider that delivers electronic components, embedded solutions, and design and supply chain services to industrial and commercial customers.

providers.name: Avon Products
providers.description: Avon Products is a global manufacturer and marketer of beauty and related products, primarily distributed through a network of independent sales representatives.

providers.name: Hubbell
providers.description: Hubbell is a global manufacturer of high-quality electrical and electronic products for non-residential and residential construction, industrial, and utility applications. The company has provided trusted infrastructure solutions since 1888 across power and utilities, lighting and controls, wiring and electrical, and datacom product categories serving commercial, data center, industrial, healthcare, telecom, and water and gas markets.

providers.name: Lexmark International
providers.description: Lexmark International is a global imaging and IoT solutions leader that helps customers worldwide realize the full potential of their information through printers, multifunction devices, and managed print services. As of 2024, Lexmark was acquired by Xerox Holdings Corporation. Public developer APIs are not currently advertised through an open developer portal.

providers.name: Lincoln Electric Holdings
providers.description: Lincoln Electric Holdings is a global manufacturer of arc welding products, robotic welding systems, plasma and oxyfuel cutting equipment, and brazing and soldering alloys. The company also offers connected welding solutions and equipment monitoring software for industrial environments.

providers.name: BrightSpring Health Services
providers.description: BrightSpring Health Services is a leading Fortune 500 provider of comprehensive home and community-based health services for complex populations. The company operates across three primary service lines: Provider Services (home health, rehabilitation, neurorehabilitation, personal care), Pharmacy Services (specialty infusion, home and community-based pharmacy dispensing over 40 million prescriptions annually), and Managed Care (home-based primary care with demonstrated 44% reduction in hospitalizations). BrightSpring operates multiple clinical brands including Adoration Home Health, Amerita specialty infusion, and All Ways Caring.

providers.name: Fortive
providers.description: Fortive Corporation is a Fortune 500 diversified industrial technology conglomerate headquartered in Everett, Washington. The company operates across two main segments, Advanced Healthcare Solutions and Intelligent Operating Solutions, providing essential technologies for medical device safety, radiation protection, workflow automation, hazard detection, and predictive maintenance through its operating companies. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Fortive at the parent company level. Most APIs and developer resources are maintained by Fortive's individual operating companies.

providers.name: Marvell Technology
providers.description: Marvell Technology, Inc. is a Fortune 500 fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. The company designs and develops data infrastructure semiconductor solutions including custom ASICs, data processing units, Ethernet controllers, optical and copper PHYs, switches, and storage controllers used in data centers, enterprise networking, carrier infrastructure, automotive, and consumer markets. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Marvell. Public developer documentation is gated behind a customer support portal and is not openly accessible.

providers.name: Old National Bancorp
providers.description: Old National Bancorp is a regional bank holding company headquartered in Indiana and a Fortune 1000 firm that provides consumer banking, commercial banking, mortgage, and wealth management services across the U.S. Midwest and Southeast. The bank operates branch and digital banking channels including mobile and online banking, bill pay, and Zelle. Old National does not publish a public developer portal or external open banking API.

providers.name: Organon
providers.description: Organon & Co. is a Fortune 500 global healthcare company focused on improving the health of women throughout their lives. Spun off from Merck in 2021, Organon's portfolio spans women's health, biosimilars, and established medicines across more than 140 markets worldwide. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Organon. No public developer APIs or documentation portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Owens & Minor
providers.description: Owens & Minor is a global Fortune 500 healthcare solutions company providing essential products and services to healthcare providers and manufacturers across the continuum of care, including medical and surgical supplies distribution, home healthcare equipment (Apria, Byram Healthcare), and outsourced logistics. No public APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: GE HealthCare Technologies
providers.description: GE HealthCare Technologies (NASDAQ: GEHC) is a global medical technology, pharmaceutical diagnostics, and digital solutions innovator providing imaging, ultrasound, patient care solutions, and pharmaceutical diagnostics. Spun off from General Electric in January 2023 and headquartered in Chicago, Illinois.

providers.name: IDEX Corporation
providers.description: IDEX Corporation (NYSE: IEX) is a global engineered products company that designs and manufactures pumps, flow meters, valves, fluidics systems, precision components, and fire and safety equipment. IDEX serves health, science, water, energy, semiconductor, aerospace, fire and safety, and industrial markets through three segments: Fluid and Metering Technologies, Health and Science Technologies, and Fire and Safety / Diversified Products.

providers.name: INTL FCStone
providers.description: INTL FCStone Inc. (rebranded as StoneX Group in 2020) is a Fortune 100 financial services organization providing execution, risk management, advisory services, market intelligence, and post-trade services across asset classes and global markets including commodities, equities, fixed income, foreign exchange, and securities.

providers.name: L-3 Communications
providers.description: L-3 Communications was a U.S. defense prime contractor specializing in command, control, communications, intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (C3ISR) systems, aircraft modernization and maintenance, and government services. In 2019 L-3 merged with Harris Corporation to form L3Harris Technologies, which continues the legacy product lines and is now ranked among the top U.S. defense contractors. No public developer API has been documented.

providers.name: Science Applications International Corporation (SAIC)
providers.description: Science Applications International Corporation (SAIC) is a Reston, Virginia based technology integrator that delivers mission IT, enterprise IT, engineering services, and professional services to U.S. federal civilian, defense, intelligence community, and space customers. With approximately 24,000 employees and roughly $7.3 billion in annual revenue, SAIC focuses on direct technical support and integration for government organizations, spanning CJADC2, data and AI, digital transformation, quantum technologies, cloud, cybersecurity, digital workplace, digital engineering, and systems integration. SAIC has expanded its capabilities through acquisitions including Engility (2018), Unisys Federal (2020), Halfaker (2021, DoD healthcare), Koverse (2021, secure data lake for classified environments), and Forfeiture Support Associates (2023). No public REST APIs, developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, or open source GitHub organization have been identified for SAIC — its software and platforms are delivered under federal contract to government customers rather than as externally-consumable developer products.

providers.name: Viacom
providers.description: Viacom was an American mass media conglomerate that merged with CBS Corporation in December 2019 to form ViacomCBS (later rebranded as Paramount Global). The combined entity, which included brands such as CBS, MTV, Nickelodeon, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount Pictures, Showtime, and Paramount+, was subsequently acquired by Skydance Media and ceased to exist as an independent public company in August 2025. Viacom maintained open source software through its GitHub organization (ViacomInc), including tools for Roku channel development, tvOS UI components, and broadcast calendar utilities. No public external developer API program was offered.

providers.name: Alleghany Corporation
providers.description: Alleghany Corporation is a holding company engaged in property and casualty reinsurance and insurance through its subsidiaries, with additional investments in non-financial businesses held via Alleghany Capital. Founded in 1929 by railroad entrepreneurs Oris and Mantis Van Sweringen, the company transitioned over decades from rail holdings into specialty insurance and reinsurance, and is headquartered at One Rockefeller Plaza in New York City. Its principal insurance subsidiaries are Transatlantic Reinsurance Company (TransRe), a global reinsurer founded in 1977 with roughly 600 employees across 23 offices and more than $40 billion in claims paid to date; RSUI Group, a wholesale excess and surplus (E&S) underwriter spanning Property, Casualty, Professional Liability, Management Liability, and Binding Authority lines; and CapSpecialty, a specialty casualty and surety underwriter. Alleghany Capital holds non-insurance operating companies including toy and collectibles maker Jazwares (Squishmallows, Pokémon, Roblox, Fortnite licensed lines). On March 21, 2022, Berkshire Hathaway announced an $11.6 billion all-cash acquisition of Alleghany at $848.02 per share, which closed in October 2022. Alleghany now operates as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Berkshire Hathaway, contributing approximately $8.8 billion in 2025 gross premiums written and roughly $14 billion in insurance float to the parent. As a holding company whose operating units distribute exclusively through reinsurance intermediaries, wholesale brokers, and independent agents, Alleghany and its subsidiaries do not publish a developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, or any other machine-readable API artifacts; the only digital surfaces exposed publicly are gated broker and agent login portals.

providers.name: FM (FM Global)
providers.description: FM (formerly FM Global) is a mutual insurance company specializing in commercial and industrial property insurance, loss prevention engineering, and risk management research. FM operates through six business units including FM, FM Affiliated, FM Approvals, FM Boiler Re, FM Cargo, and FM Renewable Energy, and is one of the largest commercial property insurers in the world. This repository tracks the FM (fm.com) entity and any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts. The abbreviation "FM" is also used in unrelated contexts (Facilities Management, FM radio broadcasting, financial management); this repository is scoped to the FM Global commercial property insurer that owns the fm.com domain. No public APIs or developer programs are currently published.

providers.name: Hartford Financial Services Group
providers.description: The Hartford Financial Services Group is a leading provider of property and casualty insurance, group benefits, and mutual funds and ETFs in the United States. This repository tracks public APIs, developer resources, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with The Hartford. No public developer APIs have been published at this time.

providers.name: Hartford Insurance
providers.description: The Hartford is a leading provider of property and casualty insurance, group benefits, and mutual funds in the United States, serving consumers, small businesses, and large corporations. This repository captures the APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts for Hartford Insurance. This is an alias of the hartford-financial-services-group repository. No public developer APIs have been published at this time.

providers.name: Interpublic Group
providers.description: The Interpublic Group of Companies (IPG) is one of the world's largest advertising and marketing services holding companies, with networks including McCann Worldgroup, IPG Mediabrands, FCB, MullenLowe Group, and Acxiom. In 2024 Omnicom announced its acquisition of IPG and operates combined brand operations under omc.com. IPG does not publish a unified public developer portal or open REST APIs; technology surfaces are delivered through agency-network products such as Acxiom data services and Mediabrands' identity and measurement platforms.

providers.name: Marsh & McLennan
providers.description: Marsh & McLennan Companies is a global professional services firm offering clients advice and solutions in risk, strategy, and people through Marsh, Guy Carpenter, Mercer, and Oliver Wyman. The firm does not currently publish a public developer portal or self-service APIs; data exchange with clients is conducted through engagement-specific integrations.

providers.name: MassMutual
providers.description: MassMutual (Massachusetts Mutual Life Insurance Company) is a leading mutual life insurance company providing life insurance, disability income insurance, long-term care insurance, retirement and annuity products, and investment management services. This repository tracks publicly available APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with MassMutual.

providers.name: Owens-Illinois (O-I Glass)
providers.description: Owens-Illinois (now O-I Glass) is one of the world's leading manufacturers of glass containers, supplying glass packaging to the food, beverage, beer, wine, spirits, and pharmaceutical industries. No public APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Bright Horizons Family Solutions
providers.description: Bright Horizons Family Solutions Inc. (NYSE: BFAM) is the largest provider of employer-sponsored child care in the United States, headquartered in Newton, Massachusetts and founded in 1986 by Linda Mason and Roger Brown. The company operates more than 1,000 early-education and child-care centers across the US, UK, Netherlands, and India, serving roughly 1,450 employer clients through three core lines: Full Service Center-Based Child Care (on-site and near-site centers for employer-sponsored families), Back-Up Care (last-minute child, adult/elder, and pet care via in-home and in-center networks), and Educational Advisory Services. The Educational Advisory segment is anchored by EdAssist by Bright Horizons (tuition assistance, student loan repayment, and workforce education administration covering 257 employer clients, 4.7 million eligible learners, and more than $1 billion in education and loan payments administered annually), College Coach (college admissions coaching delivered as an employee benefit), and Sittercity (consumer caregiver marketplace acquired in 2020 and offered through corporate benefits). Bright Horizons sells exclusively to enterprise HR and benefits buyers — 72 of the Fortune 1000's top 100 companies use EdAssist — and does not publish public APIs, SDKs, a developer portal, status page, or a public GitHub organization. The brighthorizons GitHub org exists but contains zero public repositories. This profile documents the corporate structure, segment portfolio, and employer-benefit positioning of a child-care and family-benefits operator that runs a closed B2B technology stack with no third-party developer surface.

providers.name: Conagra Brands
providers.description: Conagra Brands is a leading North American branded consumer packaged goods (CPG) food company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. Its portfolio of iconic frozen, refrigerated, and shelf-stable brands includes Marie Callender's, Healthy Choice, Slim Jim, Reddi-wip, Hunt's, Banquet, Birds Eye, Duncan Hines, and Orville Redenbacher's. Conagra internally describes itself as API-first across its digital estate, but does not publish any public developer APIs at this time. Partner integrations such as foodservice, retail, and supplier portals are managed via direct B2B agreements rather than a public developer surface.

providers.name: Cummins
providers.description: Cummins is a global power leader that designs, manufactures, distributes, and services diesel and natural gas engines, electric and hybrid powertrains, electrified power systems, components such as filtration, aftertreatment, turbochargers, fuel systems, controls systems, air handling systems, automated transmissions, and electric power generation systems. Cummins serves customers in approximately 190 countries and territories through a network of more than 600 company-owned and independent distributor locations and approximately 7,200 dealer locations.

providers.name: Discovery Communications
providers.description: Discovery Communications was a global media company providing original and purchased programming across multiple distribution platforms before merging with WarnerMedia in 2022 to form Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD), a leading global media and entertainment company whose portfolio spans HBO Max, Discovery Channel, CNN, Warner Bros. film studios, DC, Food Network, HGTV, and other television, film, and streaming brands. No public developer APIs are documented at the corporate level; technical and partnership inquiries are handled at the individual brand or business-unit level.

providers.name: EP Energy
providers.description: EP Energy Corporation was an independent exploration and production company engaged in the acquisition and development of unconventional onshore oil and natural gas properties in the United States. EP Energy filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in October 2019 and emerged in October 2020, with assets later acquired by IKAV in March 2022. The company does not maintain any public APIs, SDKs, or developer resources.

providers.name: First Solar
providers.description: First Solar is a leading global provider of comprehensive photovoltaic (PV) solar energy solutions, designing and manufacturing thin-film solar modules. No public developer portal or open APIs have been identified at this time.

providers.name: FMC Technologies (now TechnipFMC)
providers.description: FMC Technologies was a Houston-based energy services and equipment company serving the upstream oil and gas industry, particularly subsea, surface, and measurement solutions for hydrocarbon production. In January 2017 FMC Technologies completed its merger with Technip to form TechnipFMC, a global energy services company serving the subsea, surface, and offshore project markets. This repository tracks the legacy FMC Technologies brand and any successor APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts associated with the merged TechnipFMC entity. No public APIs or developer programs are currently published.

providers.name: Fox Corporation
providers.description: Fox Corporation is a U.S. media company whose portfolio includes Fox News Media, Fox Sports, Fox Entertainment, Fox Television Stations, and the ad-supported streaming service Tubi. Fox is a Fortune 500 consumer of cloud, AI, and media technology APIs (notably AWS as preferred AI cloud provider) but does not publish a public developer portal at the corporate level.

providers.name: HiddenLayer
providers.description: HiddenLayer is an Austin, Texas-based AI security company founded in March 2022 by Chris Sestito (CEO), Tanner Burns (Chief Scientist), and Jim Ballard (CIO) — former Cylance researchers who encountered a real-world attack on production ML models. HiddenLayer builds an AI Security Platform that protects machine learning and generative AI systems across their entire lifecycle, comprising four integrated modules: AI Discovery (catalogs AI assets and eliminates shadow AI), AI Supply Chain Security (Model Scanner inspects models, weights, and pickle/RDS files for malicious payloads and backdoors), AI Attack Simulation (continuous adversarial red-teaming for agentic and generative systems), and AI Runtime Security / AIDR (a real-time detection-and-response firewall using deterministic classifiers that sit outside the model inference path to detect prompt injection, jailbreaks, indirect attacks, data leakage, and malicious tool calls in agentic and MCP systems). The platform exposes native connectors for CI/CD, MLOps, SIEM/SOAR, API gateways, and major data and cloud platforms, plus guardrail integrations for OpenAI Agents, LangChain, AWS Strands, Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure APIM, and a GitHub Action for Model Scanner. HiddenLayer publishes Python, TypeScript, and Java/Kotlin SDKs and research-grade tooling such as HiddenPickle (Python pickle disassembler/patcher) and HiddenPromise (R .rdx/.rdb/.rds disassembler). The company has raised $56M total ($50M Series A in September 2023 led by M12 / Microsoft's Venture Fund and Moore Strategic Ventures, with Booz Allen Ventures, IBM Ventures, Capital One Ventures, and Ten Eleven Ventures participating) and serves Fortune 500 enterprises, financial services, and US Federal agencies. The HiddenLayer SaaS console and REST API are gated behind enterprise sales and not publicly self-serve, placing this profile in Tier-3 (enterprise-gated) coverage.

providers.name: J.C. Penney
providers.description: J.C. Penney Company, Inc. (JCPenney) is an American department store chain offering apparel, accessories, beauty, jewelry, footwear, and home goods. The company emerged from Chapter 11 bankruptcy in late 2020 and continues to operate hundreds of department stores across the United States and Puerto Rico.

providers.name: Johnson Controls
providers.description: Johnson Controls is a global diversified technology and multi-industrial leader serving customers in over 150 countries, providing products, services, and solutions for buildings (HVAC, fire, security, building automation), energy storage, and connected building platforms (Metasys, OpenBlue). No public, self-service developer portal or OpenAPI is currently published; partner and customer integrations are typically delivered through the OpenBlue and Metasys product lines.

providers.name: Kyndryl
providers.description: Kyndryl is a Fortune 500 IT infrastructure services company spun off from IBM in 2021. The company designs, builds, manages, and modernizes mission-critical technology systems across cloud, mainframe, networking, digital workplace, security, applications, data, and AI. Kyndryl operates the Kyndryl Bridge integration and observability platform, runs the Kyndryl Vital design studios, and partners with hyperscalers including AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and SAP. No public developer API has been documented.

providers.name: Leidos
providers.description: Leidos, a Fortune 500 digital and mission innovator, delivers solutions at the intersection of national security, health, and critical infrastructure. With a global workforce of approximately 47,000, the company is executing its NorthStar 2030 strategy focused on five growth engines: space and maritime, energy infrastructure, digital modernization and cyber, mission software, and managed health. No public REST APIs or developer portal have been identified.

providers.name: Marathon Oil
providers.description: Marathon Oil was an independent international energy company that engaged in the exploration, production, and marketing of liquid hydrocarbons and natural gas. The company was acquired by ConocoPhillips in 2024, and its public web presence now redirects to ConocoPhillips. No public developer APIs have been identified.

providers.name: Nestlé
providers.description: Nestlé S.A. is the world's largest food and beverage company by revenue, headquartered in Vevey, Switzerland. Its product portfolio spans coffee (Nescafé, Nespresso), water, pet food (Purina), baby and infant nutrition (Gerber, Cerelac), confectionery (KitKat), dairy, and health science. No public developer portal or external API offering has been identified for Nestlé; integrations with retailers and partners are handled through private B2B systems rather than a self-serve developer program.

providers.name: onsemi
providers.description: ON Semiconductor (now branded as onsemi) is a global supplier of semiconductor-based solutions for power efficiency, image sensing, and signal processing in automotive, industrial, and other applications. No public APIs are documented at this time.

providers.name: Take-Two Interactive Software
providers.description: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. is a leading developer, publisher, and marketer of interactive entertainment. The company operates through its publishing labels: Rockstar Games (Grand Theft Auto, Red Dead Redemption), 2K (NBA 2K, Borderlands, Civilization, BioShock, Mafia), Private Division, and Zynga (mobile games). Headquartered in New York City, Take-Two is a Fortune 500 company with studios across North America, Europe, and Asia. No public developer API is currently available.

providers.name: Boston Scientific
providers.description: Boston Scientific is a global medical device manufacturer that develops, manufactures, and markets devices used in interventional medical specialties including interventional cardiology, cardiac rhythm management, electrophysiology, urology, pelvic health, endoscopy, neuromodulation, and peripheral interventions. The company advances science for life by transforming patient lives through innovative medical solutions.

providers.name: Celgene
providers.description: Celgene Corporation was a global biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of innovative therapies for cancer and immune-inflammatory diseases. Celgene was acquired by Bristol Myers Squibb (BMS) in November 2019 and its operations are now consolidated under BMS. No public developer API has been identified; engagement is organized through BMS clinical trials, study connect, and investigator-sponsored research portals.

providers.name: First Horizon Corporation
providers.description: First Horizon Corporation (NYSE: FHN), headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee, is a regional financial-services holding company operating across 12 southeastern U.S. states through its principal subsidiary, First Horizon Bank. The franchise reports roughly $84 billion in total assets, $67 billion in deposits, and approximately 410 banking centers as of Q1 2026. Business lines include consumer and small-business banking, commercial and specialty lending, private banking and wealth management, and FHN Financial fixed- income capital markets. The company was founded in 1864 as First National Bank of Memphis, rebranded as First Tennessee in 1977, became First Horizon National Corporation in 2004, and shortened its name to First Horizon Corporation following the 2020 IberiaBank merger. In February 2022 First Horizon announced a $13.4 billion all-cash acquisition by Toronto-Dominion Bank; the parties mutually terminated the merger on May 4, 2023, citing regulatory uncertainty around the deal's closing timeline, with TD paying a $225 million termination fee plus a previously agreed $25 million reimbursement to First Horizon. First Horizon does not publish a public developer API portal. Customer account data is reachable for fintech use cases only through US open-banking aggregators (Plaid, MX, Finicity, Akoya) and through emerging Financial Data Exchange (FDX) APIs that will be required of covered data providers under the CFPB Section 1033 Personal Financial Data Rights rule. Commercial APIs for treasury management, ACH origination, wire initiation, and host-to-host file transfer are available to corporate clients under direct contract through First Horizon Treasury Management Services but are not publicly documented.

providers.name: IQVIA
providers.description: IQVIA empowers life sciences organizations to accelerate innovation, improve patient outcomes, and bring treatments to market faster through advanced analytics and technology. IQVIA is a Fortune 500 company offering data, analytics, clinical research, and connected intelligence services.

providers.name: Kemper
providers.description: The Kemper family of companies is one of the nation's leading insurers. With approximately $13 billion in assets, Kemper is improving the world of insurance by offering personalized solutions for individuals, families and businesses.

providers.name: MetLife
providers.description: MetLife is a Fortune 500 insurance and financial services company offering life, auto, home, dental, vision, and other employee benefits. This entry captures publicly available APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts for MetLife.

providers.name: Nationwide
providers.description: Nationwide Mutual Insurance Company is a Fortune 100 American mutual insurance and financial services company providing auto, home, life, business, and retirement products. This repository captures the APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts for Nationwide.

providers.name: Old Republic International
providers.description: Old Republic International is one of the nation's largest publicly held insurance organizations, providing general insurance, title insurance, and life and accident insurance through its subsidiaries. No public developer APIs have been documented at the parent company level at this time.

providers.name: PNC Financial Services Group
providers.description: PNC Financial Services Group is one of the largest diversified financial services institutions in the United States, organized around customers, communities, and employees offering retail and corporate banking, asset management, and residential mortgage services. This repository tracks APIs, SDKs, and other developer resources associated with PNC Financial Services Group.

providers.name: Quintiles Transnational Holdings
providers.description: Quintiles Transnational Holdings was a Fortune 500 contract research organization (CRO) that provided biopharmaceutical development and commercial outsourcing services to the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device industries. In October 2016, Quintiles merged with IMS Health to form IQVIA, a leading provider of advanced analytics, technology solutions, and contract research services to the life sciences industry. The legacy Quintiles entity no longer operates as an independent company and does not maintain a public API program; all developer-facing capabilities are now part of IQVIA.

providers.name: Tri Pointe Homes
providers.description: Tri Pointe Homes (NYSE: TPH) is a US homebuilder headquartered in Orange County, California. Founded in 2009, it builds single-family and multifamily new homes across 13 states plus the District of Columbia under a unified Tri Pointe Homes brand that consolidated legacy regional brands including Pardee Homes, Maracay, Quadrant Homes, Winchester Homes, and Trendmaker Homes. The company also offers ancillary services through Tri Pointe Connect (mortgage), Tri Pointe Assurance (title and escrow), and Tri Pointe Advantage (insurance). Tri Pointe operates no public developer program, no documented API, and no GitHub presence; its digital surface is limited to a marketing site (tripointehomes.com), an investor portal, a blog, and a careers portal.

providers.name: Cooper Tire & Rubber
providers.description: Cooper Tire & Rubber Company is an American manufacturer of replacement tires for passenger cars, light trucks, SUVs, and commercial vehicles, founded in 1914 and headquartered in Findlay, Ohio. Cooper was acquired by The Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company in June 2021 and now operates as a subsidiary, retaining the Cooper brand alongside Goodyear. The Cooper brand portfolio covers all-season, winter, all-terrain, and sport performance tires distributed through retailers and dealers worldwide. Cooper Tire does not publish a public developer program or REST APIs. Its digital presence is consumer-facing tire selection, retailer locators, and post-purchase tire registration.

providers.name: Grainger
providers.description: W.W. Grainger, Inc. is a Fortune 500 industrial supply company headquartered in Lake Forest, Illinois. Grainger distributes maintenance, repair, and operating (MRO) products and services to businesses, government agencies, and institutions across North America, Japan, and the United Kingdom. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Grainger. No public developer APIs or documentation portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: International Game Technology
providers.description: International Game Technology (IGT) is a global gaming company that delivers entertaining and responsible gaming experiences across all gaming channels and regulated segments, including lottery, gaming machines, sports betting, and digital gaming. IGT does not currently offer a public developer API program; its technical resources are delivered through licensed B2B partner channels.

providers.name: KBR
providers.description: KBR is a Fortune 500 company that delivers science, technology, and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world, spanning defense, intelligence, space, energy transition, and sustainable infrastructure markets.

providers.name: Wolverine World Wide
providers.description: Wolverine World Wide is a leading designer, manufacturer, and marketer of branded footwear, apparel, and accessories. Brands include Merrell, Saucony, Wolverine, Sperry, Sweaty Betty, and Hush Puppies. The company operates global wholesale, direct-to-consumer, and digital commerce channels. Wolverine World Wide does not currently expose a public developer API.

providers.name: Calpine
providers.description: Calpine Corporation was a major U.S. energy company headquartered in Houston, Texas, and was the largest generator of electricity from natural gas and geothermal energy in the United States. It operated 80 power plants with approximately 26,035 megawatts of generation capacity, including The Geysers, the world's largest geothermal complex. Calpine also operated the Champion Energy retail electricity subsidiary serving deregulated markets. As of January 2026, Constellation Energy completed its acquisition of Calpine for $16.4 billion, making it a business unit of Constellation. Calpine does not publish a public developer API program.

providers.name: Darling Ingredients
providers.description: Darling Ingredients is a global developer and producer of sustainable natural ingredients from edible and inedible bio-nutrients, creating products for the food, pet food, feed, fuel, bioenergy, and fertilizer industries. Darling operates Diamond Green Diesel as a renewable diesel joint venture with Valero, and brands such as Rousselot (gelatin and collagen), Sonac, CTH, and EnviroFlight. Darling does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Global Partners LP
providers.description: Global Partners LP is a leading independent owner, supplier, and operator of liquid energy terminals, fueling locations, and retail experiences. The company distributes gasoline, distillates, residual oil, renewable fuels, crude oil, and propane across the Northeast United States through an integrated network of terminals, gas stations, and convenience stores.

providers.name: MDU Resources Group
providers.description: MDU Resources Group is a diversified natural resources company with operations in regulated energy delivery, construction materials, and construction services. No public developer APIs are currently documented.

providers.name: Phillips 66
providers.description: Phillips 66 is a diversified energy manufacturing and logistics company with midstream, chemicals, refining, and marketing and specialties businesses. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts for Phillips 66.

providers.name: Popular
providers.description: Popular Inc. is a financial holding company offering retail, mortgage, and commercial banking services through its principal subsidiaries Banco Popular de Puerto Rico and Popular Bank in the continental United States.

providers.name: Public Service Enterprise Group
providers.description: Public Service Enterprise Group (PSEG) is a publicly traded diversified energy holding company headquartered in Newark, New Jersey. Through its subsidiaries including PSE&G and PSEG Power, the company provides regulated electric and natural gas distribution and operates electric power generation across the northeastern United States. PSEG is a Fortune 500 company. No public developer APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Benchmark Electronics
providers.description: Benchmark Electronics, Inc. is an advanced electronics engineering and manufacturing services (EMS) company headquartered in Tempe, Arizona. The company provides integrated design, engineering, and manufacturing services from prototypes to high-volume production, including procurement, logistics, and repair. Benchmark serves original equipment manufacturers in defense, medical technologies, commercial aerospace, industrial, next-gen communications, advanced computing, and semiconductor capital equipment markets. The company operates approximately 22 locations in 8 countries with around 13,000 employees.

providers.name: Big Lots
providers.description: Big Lots is a discount retailer offering a wide assortment of brand-name closeout merchandise including furniture, food, consumables, seasonal products, soft home, hard home, and electronics. Big Lots operated hundreds of stores across the United States. In 2024, Big Lots filed for bankruptcy and its brand and operations were acquired by Nexus Capital Management.

providers.name: ConAgra Foods
providers.description: ConAgra Foods, Inc. was the prior corporate name of Conagra Brands. In 2015 the company spun off its foodservice ingredients business as Lamb Weston and renamed the remaining packaged-foods business to Conagra Brands, Inc. This profile is preserved as a historical alias; the active company profile lives at the conagra-brands repository. No public developer APIs were ever published under the ConAgra Foods brand.

providers.name: Dillard's
providers.description: Dillard's is an American department store chain offering apparel, footwear, cosmetics, handbags, menswear, and home goods from top brands. The retailer operates stores across the United States and an e-commerce site, with no publicly documented developer APIs at this time.

providers.name: Foot Locker
providers.description: Foot Locker is a global retailer of athletic footwear and apparel, operating stores under banners including Foot Locker, Kids Foot Locker, Lady Foot Locker, Champs Sports, Eastbay, and Footaction. Foot Locker does not publish a public developer portal or open API. Integrations with Foot Locker (loyalty, gift cards, retail media, e-commerce affiliate, supplier EDI) are arranged through partner programs and require commercial agreements.

providers.name: General Mills
providers.description: General Mills is a leading global food company that manufactures and markets branded consumer foods including Cheerios, Betty Crocker, Pillsbury, Haagen- Dazs, Nature Valley, Old El Paso, and Progresso. General Mills operates in over 100 countries. The company does not currently publish a public developer API portal and primarily relies on EDI and direct supply chain integrations with retail partners.

providers.name: Harman International
providers.description: Harman International, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Samsung Electronics, is a global leader in connected technologies for automotive, consumer, and enterprise markets, including connected car systems, audio products, professional solutions, and connected services. Harman does not currently publish a public developer portal or open APIs; integrations with Harman platforms (such as Ignite, Ready Connect, and audio brands like JBL, Harman Kardon, and AKG) are typically delivered through commercial partnerships and OEM agreements.

providers.name: Hasbro
providers.description: Hasbro is a global play and entertainment company committed to making the world a better place for children and their families through brands and franchises including NERF, MAGIC: THE GATHERING, MY LITTLE PONY, and TRANSFORMERS. This repository tracks public APIs, developer resources, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Hasbro. No public developer APIs have been published at this time.

providers.name: HD Supply Holdings
providers.description: HD Supply is one of the largest industrial distributors in North America, providing maintenance, repair, and operations products and value-added services to multifamily, hospitality, healthcare, and government facilities. HD Supply operates as a wholly owned subsidiary of The Home Depot following its acquisition in 2020.

providers.name: Host Hotels & Resorts
providers.description: Host Hotels & Resorts is a leading lodging real estate investment trust (REIT) that owns luxury and upper-upscale hotels operating under premium brands in major U.S. and international markets. No public APIs are offered.

providers.name: Hyatt Hotels
providers.description: Hyatt Hotels Corporation is a global hospitality company managing a portfolio of hotel, resort, and residential brands. This repository tracks public APIs, developer resources, and integration touchpoints associated with Hyatt Hotels.

providers.name: Jarden
providers.description: Jarden Corporation was an American consumer products conglomerate that owned brands across Outdoor Solutions (Coleman, K2 Sports, Marmot, Rawlings), Consumer Solutions (Crock-Pot, Mr. Coffee, Sunbeam, Oster, FoodSaver), Branded Consumables (Yankee Candle, First Alert, Diamond Match), and Process Solutions. Jarden was acquired by Newell Rubbermaid on April 15, 2016, with the combined entity rebranded as Newell Brands. As such, Jarden no longer exists as an independent company and does not maintain its own APIs.

providers.name: Leggett and Platt
providers.description: Leggett and Platt is a diversified manufacturer that designs and produces engineered components and products found in many homes, offices, vehicles, and aircraft, including bedding components, automotive seating, hydraulic cylinders, and aerospace tube assemblies. No public REST APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Lululemon Athletica
providers.description: Lululemon Athletica is a designer, distributor, and retailer of technical athletic apparel, footwear, and accessories for women, men, and girls.
