Lululemon does not currently publish a public developer portal or open APIs; digital integrations are handled through partner relationships and internal ecommerce, retail, and supply-chain platforms.

providers.name: McGraw Hill Financial
providers.description: McGraw Hill Financial was a financial information and analytics company providing credit ratings, benchmarks, and analytics to global capital and commodity markets. The company was renamed S&P Global in 2016. No public developer APIs are currently documented under the McGraw Hill Financial brand.

providers.name: McKinsey & Company
providers.description: McKinsey & Company is a global management consulting firm advising leading businesses, governments, non-profit organizations, and institutions on strategy, operations, technology, and transformation. The firm operates in more than 65 countries and runs QuantumBlack, its AI and analytics arm. No public developer portal or external APIs have been identified for McKinsey & Company; its proprietary platforms (e.g., platform.mckinsey.com) are gated to client engagements and authenticated users only.

providers.name: MGM Resorts International
providers.description: MGM Resorts International is a global entertainment company with national and international locations featuring best-in-class hotels and casinos, state-of-the-art meetings and conference spaces, and dining and entertainment venues. This repository captures the APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts for MGM Resorts International.

providers.name: Monsanto
providers.description: Monsanto was a global agricultural products company that produced seeds, biotechnology trait products, and herbicides before being acquired by Bayer AG in 2018. Operations and brands have since been integrated into the Bayer Crop Science division.

providers.name: Mutual of Omaha
providers.description: Mutual of Omaha is a Fortune 500 mutual insurance and financial services company headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska. The company offers life insurance, Medicare supplement insurance, disability insurance, long-term care insurance, annuities, and banking products to individuals and businesses across the United States. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Mutual of Omaha. No public developer APIs or documentation portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: NBC
providers.description: NBC (National Broadcasting Company) is a major American commercial broadcast television network and a subsidiary of Comcast through NBCUniversal. NBC produces news (NBC News, Today), entertainment, late-night, and sports programming (Sunday Night Football, Olympic Games). NBC and parent company NBCUniversal do not publish a public developer portal. Programmatic advertising APIs (NBCUniversal One Platform) and streaming partner integrations (Peacock) are offered only through direct sales relationships rather than self-serve developer signup.

providers.name: NBTY
providers.description: NBTY was a leading global vertically integrated manufacturer, marketer, distributor, and retailer of vitamins and nutritional supplements before being renamed The Nature's Bounty Co., which was subsequently sold and reorganized. No public APIs exist under the NBTY name.

providers.name: New Residential Investment Corp (Rithm Capital)
providers.description: New Residential Investment Corp (NYSE: NRZ) was a mortgage real estate investment trust (REIT) that **rebranded as Rithm Capital Corp (NYSE: RITM) in August 2022** to reflect its evolution from a pure mortgage REIT into a diversified global asset manager focused on real estate, credit, and financial services. Rithm Capital is headquartered in New York City, led by Chairman & CEO Michael Nierenberg, and as of 2024 reported approximately $46 billion in assets under management, ~$5.2 billion in revenue, and ~6,045 employees across its operating businesses (Newrez mortgage origination/servicing, Genesis Capital business-purpose lending, Sculptor Capital Management alternatives platform, Rithm Property Trust REIT [formerly Great Ajax], Adoor single-family rental, Crestline credit, and Elecor Properties [formerly Paramount Group] office real estate). This profile carries forward the legacy `new-residential-investment` repo identity under the API Evangelist network. The active corporate identity, public filings, and investor communications are at rithmcap.com. Rithm Capital and its subsidiaries operate as financial-services businesses serving institutional investors, mortgage borrowers, and real-estate sponsors. None of the public-facing Rithm Capital, Newrez, Genesis Capital, Sculptor, Rithm Property Trust, Adoor, Crestline, or Elecor Properties websites expose a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, REST/GraphQL API, SDK, CLI, webhook system, status page, or RSS feed. There are no public GitHub organizations of substance for any of the brand surfaces (the `newrez` GitHub org exists with zero public repositories; `rithmcap` does not exist). Integration with these businesses occurs through traditional B2B mortgage / capital-markets channels, not a public API surface.

providers.name: News
providers.description: Headlines currently published on a range of news sources and blogs

providers.name: Nortek
providers.description: Nortek is a global manufacturer of HVAC, data center cooling, and cleanroom systems, organized into three divisions: Nortek Air Solutions, Nortek Data Center Cooling, and Nortek Cleanroom Solutions. No public developer portal or OpenAPI specifications have been identified at this time; this repository tracks Nortek for future API discovery and integration intelligence.

providers.name: Owens Corning
providers.description: Owens Corning is a global Fortune 500 building and industrial materials leader committed to building a sustainable future through material innovation, providing roofing, insulation, composite materials, and doors. No public APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Plexus
providers.description: Plexus is a global manufacturing and product development company that helps customers in highly regulated industries (Aerospace/Defense, Healthcare/Life Sciences, Industrial, and Semiconductor Capital Equipment) design, manufacture, and service their products. Plexus does not currently publish a public developer API; this index tracks customer/supplier portals and corporate web properties.

providers.name: Publix Super Markets
providers.description: Publix Super Markets is one of the largest employee-owned supermarket chains in the United States, headquartered in Lakeland, Florida. It operates grocery stores, pharmacies, delivery, catering, and online ordering services across the southeastern United States. Publix is a Fortune 500 company. No public developer APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: PVH Corp
providers.description: PVH Corp, formerly known as the Phillips-Van Heusen Corporation, is an American clothing company headquartered in Manhattan, New York City and listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker PVH. Founded in 1881, PVH today operates two iconic owned global brands — Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger — along with licensed brands including Kenneth Cole New York and Michael Kors. PVH divested its Heritage Brands wholesale business (Van Heusen, Arrow, Izod, Geoffrey Beene) to Authentic Brands Group in August 2021, refocusing the company on its two flagship designer lifestyle brands. PVH does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal at the corporate level; technology and commerce integrations are handled brand-by-brand and through closed wholesale, licensing, and retail technology partnerships.

providers.name: Service Properties Trust
providers.description: Service Properties Trust (NASDAQ: SVC) is a real estate investment trust (REIT) with approximately $9.9 billion invested across two asset categories: service-focused retail net lease properties and hotels. As of March 31, 2026 SVC owned 761 net lease properties (over 13.6 million sq ft) and 93 hotels (over 21,000 guest rooms) throughout the United States. The company is externally managed by The RMR Group (NASDAQ: RMR). SVC does not operate a public developer program and exposes no public APIs, OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, or webhooks; investor-facing endpoints are limited to SEC filings, press releases, email alerts, and end-of-day stock quotes.

providers.name: TRW Automotive Holdings
providers.description: TRW Automotive Holdings was one of the world's largest automotive parts suppliers, specializing in active and passive safety systems including braking systems, steering systems, suspension systems, seat belts, airbags, and advanced driver assistance systems. TRW Automotive was acquired by ZF Friedrichshafen AG in 2015 and is now part of ZF Group, operating as ZF TRW. The company's automotive safety technologies are integrated across major global OEMs. TRW no longer operates an independent developer API program; developer and partner integrations are handled through ZF Group's partner ecosystem.

providers.name: Tupperware Brands
providers.description: Tupperware Brands Corporation was an American multinational consumer goods company that manufactured and marketed premium kitchen storage, preparation, and serving products under the Tupperware brand, as well as related home product lines. The company distributed products to approximately 70 countries through independent sales force members. Tupperware Brands filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in September 2024 and underwent liquidation in 2025. The Tupperware brand name was subsequently acquired by Party Products LLC. No public developer API program was available during the company's operation.

providers.name: USG
providers.description: USG Corporation is a leading manufacturer of building products and innovative solutions for the construction industry. USG produces Sheetrock brand drywall, Durock cement board, Securock glass-mat sheathing, and a wide range of interior finishing systems. The company serves contractors, architects, and building professionals through its distributor network and provides digital tools and APIs to support the building and construction workflow.

providers.name: Williams-Sonoma
providers.description: Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a Fortune 500 American publicly traded retail company specializing in kitchenware and home furnishings. It is one of the largest e-commerce retailers in the United States. The company operates multiple brands including Williams Sonoma, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, PBteen, West Elm, Rejuvenation, Mark and Graham, and Green Row. Williams-Sonoma does not offer a public developer API. The company uses internal APIs and third-party platforms for e-commerce, registry services, and supply chain management.

providers.name: American Financial Group
providers.description: American Financial Group (AFG) is a holding company engaged primarily in property and casualty insurance, focusing on specialized commercial products for businesses, and in the sale of fixed and indexed annuities through its Great American Insurance Group and Great American Life subsidiaries. AFG serves businesses across more than 40 specialty markets including agriculture, aviation, cyber, environmental, equine, ocean marine, professional liability, and transportation.

providers.name: American International Group (AIG)
providers.description: American International Group (AIG) is one of the world's most extensive international insurance organizations, operating in more than 200 countries and jurisdictions. AIG provides a broad range of property casualty insurance, life insurance, retirement solutions, and other financial services to commercial and individual customers worldwide. The company's offerings include casualty, property, cyber, professional liability, management liability, marine, aviation, energy, trade credit, and private client insurance.

providers.name: American National Insurance
providers.description: American National Insurance Company is a multi-line insurance holding company founded in 1905 and headquartered in Galveston, Texas. The company offers life insurance, annuities, pension risk transfer, health insurance, and property and casualty insurance through multiple subsidiary companies operating in all 50 states. American National holds A-level ratings from A.M. Best, Fitch, and S&P.

providers.name: Fidelity National Financial
providers.description: Fidelity National Financial (FNF) is a leading provider of title insurance, escrow, and other title-related services, as well as transaction services to the real estate and mortgage industries. FNF also operates F&G Annuities & Life and owns technology providers including SoftPro and ServiceLink that serve the title, real estate, and mortgage workflow.

providers.name: Globe Life (Torchmark)
providers.description: Globe Life Inc. (NYSE: GL), formerly known as Torchmark Corporation, is an S&P 500 financial services holding company headquartered in McKinney, Texas. Founded in 1900, the company provides life insurance, supplemental health insurance, and annuity products through direct-to-consumer and agent distribution channels across the United States. Subsidiaries include Globe Life Liberty National Division, American Income Life Insurance Company, United American Insurance Company, Globe Life And Accident Insurance Company, and Globe Life Family Heritage Division. Revenue in 2024 was $5.78 billion with total assets of $29.1 billion. No public developer API is available; the company uses MuleSoft Anypoint Platform internally for API management and integration.

providers.name: Harris Computer
providers.description: Harris Computer is a constellation of companies acquiring and operating vertical market software businesses across the public sector, healthcare, utilities, financial services, education, and insurance markets. Harris Computer itself does not publish a unified public developer portal; APIs and integrations are delivered through its individual portfolio companies (such as Harris Local Government, Harris Utilities, Harris Healthcare, and Harris School Solutions). Harris Computer is a subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc.

providers.name: Health Net
providers.description: Health Net is a managed care organization offering health benefits to individuals, families, businesses, and beneficiaries of government sponsored programs. Health Net is a wholly owned subsidiary of Centene Corporation, one of the largest managed care companies in the United States.

providers.name: Loews Corporation
providers.description: Loews Corporation is a diversified holding company with subsidiaries operating in commercial property and casualty insurance (CNA Financial), natural gas pipelines (Boardwalk Pipelines), packaging products (Altium Packaging), and hotels (Loews Hotels). Loews Corporation does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; this index tracks the company website and consumer-facing properties for reference.

providers.name: Loews Corporation
providers.description: Loews Corporation (NYSE: L) is a diversified holding company headquartered at 9 West 57th Street, New York. Controlled by the Tisch family, the corporation pursues long-term shareholder value through four operating subsidiaries spanning insurance, energy infrastructure, hospitality, and rigid plastic packaging. The parent entity itself publishes no developer APIs, SDKs, or technical artifacts — its public surface is investor-relations, SEC filings, and press communications. This apis.yml therefore documents the parent's portfolio structure and points to each operating subsidiary for any API-bearing surface.

providers.name: Massachusetts Mutual Life Insurance
providers.description: Massachusetts Mutual Life Insurance Company (MassMutual) is a leading mutual life insurance company providing life insurance, disability income insurance, long-term care insurance, retirement and annuity products, and investment management services. This repository is an alias for the MassMutual API Evangelist profile and tracks publicly available APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts.

providers.name: New York Life
providers.description: New York Life Insurance Company is the largest mutual life insurance company in the United States, headquartered in Manhattan, New York. The company provides life insurance, fixed and variable annuities, long-term care, and investment management (through subsidiaries such as New York Life Investments / NYLIM). New York Life has maintained the highest financial-strength ratings from major rating agencies for more than a century. No public developer portal or external APIs have been identified; agent, partner, and reinsurer integrations occur through private B2B channels.

providers.name: New York Life Insurance
providers.description: New York Life Insurance Company is the largest mutual life insurance company in the United States, founded in 1845. The company provides whole, term, universal, and variable universal life insurance, long-term care and disability insurance, annuities, and asset management through New York Life Investments. Ranked #69 on the Fortune 500. No public APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Nordstrom
providers.description: Nordstrom is a leading fashion retailer offering compelling clothing, shoes, and accessories for men, women, and children through Nordstrom and Nordstrom Rack stores and online. Nordstrom does not currently operate a public developer portal or expose general-purpose APIs to third-party developers; this repository captures the company profile and any future developer-facing artifacts.

providers.name: Pacific Life
providers.description: Pacific Life is a U.S.-based insurance company providing life insurance, annuities, mutual funds, and investment products and services to individuals, businesses, and pension plans. No public APIs have been documented at this time.

providers.name: Allergan
providers.description: Allergan was a global pharmaceutical company that developed, manufactured, and commercialized branded therapeutics, devices, and biologic products across medical aesthetics, eye care, central nervous system, and gastroenterology. The company was the maker of Botox (botulinum toxin), Juvederm (injectable filler), CoolSculpting, Alphagan, Vraylar, Linzess, and Ubrelvy. AbbVie completed its $63 billion acquisition of Allergan in May 2020. The company now operates as Allergan Aesthetics, an AbbVie company. Allergan Data Labs, the digital innovation arm, built the Alle loyalty platform serving over 3 million users across nearly 20,000 medical offices and spas in the US, using machine learning for personalized consumer engagement in medical aesthetics. Allergan Aesthetics does not maintain a public developer API program.

providers.name: American Tower
providers.description: American Tower Corporation is one of the largest global REITs and a leading independent owner, operator, and developer of multitenant communications real estate. The company owns and operates approximately 225,000 communications sites globally, providing tower space and related services to wireless carriers and broadcasters across the United States, Latin America, Europe, Africa, India, and Asia-Pacific. American Tower enables wireless communications networks by leasing antenna space on its towers to mobile network operators.

providers.name: Chesapeake Energy
providers.description: Chesapeake Energy Corporation was an independent oil and natural gas exploration and production company headquartered in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, focused on unconventional natural gas and oil fields onshore in the United States. In October 2024, Chesapeake combined with Southwestern Energy to form Expand Energy Corporation, which now operates as the largest natural gas producer in the United States. Chesapeake Energy does not currently expose a public developer API; royalty owners and partners interact through the Owner Online Accounts portal, and investors are served via the Expand Energy investor relations site.

providers.name: Chevron
providers.description: Chevron Corporation is one of the world's largest integrated energy companies, with operations across upstream exploration and production, downstream refining and marketing, and the production and transportation of crude oil, natural gas, refined fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and renewable fuels. Chevron is headquartered in Houston, Texas, and operates globally under brands including Chevron, Texaco, and Caltex. Chevron does not currently publish a public consumer-facing developer API; supplier and partner integrations are handled through the Chevron Invoice and Payment Status (CIPS) system and the Supplier Relations channels, and investors and stakeholders are served through corporate, sustainability, and IR websites.

providers.name: Curtiss-Wright
providers.description: Curtiss-Wright is a global integrated business that provides highly engineered products, solutions, and services mainly to the aerospace, defense, commercial power, process, and general industrial markets. Its product portfolio spans rugged embedded computing, mission-critical avionics, electronic packaging, naval propulsion, reactor coolant pumps for nuclear power, surface treatment services, industrial valves, sensors, data acquisition systems, telemetry ground stations, emergency arresting systems for military aircraft, and electronic systems for naval shipbuilding programs. The company traces its lineage to the aviation pioneers Glenn Curtiss and the Wright brothers and today operates across the Defense Electronics, Naval & Power, and Aerospace & Industrial segments.

providers.name: Dick's Sporting Goods
providers.description: Dick's Sporting Goods is a leading omni-channel sporting goods retailer offering an extensive assortment of authentic, high-quality sports equipment, apparel, footwear, and accessories. As a Fortune 500 retailer, Dick's Sporting Goods does not currently publish a public developer portal or APIs; this repository is maintained as a placeholder for any APIs, developer tools, or machine-readable artifacts that may emerge.

providers.name: Dominion Energy
providers.description: Dominion Energy is one of the nation's largest producers and transporters of energy, providing electricity and natural gas to customers across multiple U.S. states including Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Ohio, and Utah. No public developer APIs are currently published.

providers.name: Dominion Resources
providers.description: Dominion Resources is the former name of Dominion Energy, one of the nation's largest producers and transporters of energy, providing electricity and natural gas to customers across multiple U.S. states. The company rebranded from Dominion Resources to Dominion Energy in 2017. No public developer APIs are currently published.

providers.name: Eli Lilly
providers.description: Eli Lilly and Company is a Fortune 500 global pharmaceutical company that discovers, develops, manufactures, and sells human pharmaceutical products in therapeutic areas including diabetes, oncology, immunology, and neuroscience. Eli Lilly does not currently publish a public developer API portal; the company exposes selected machine learning models through its Lilly TuneLab platform to partner biotechs but does not offer general purpose, self-serve APIs.

providers.name: EnerSys
providers.description: EnerSys is a global leader in stored energy solutions for industrial applications, manufacturing batteries, chargers, accessories, and outdoor equipment enclosures. EnerSys serves motive power, reserve power, aerospace and defense, and specialty markets. While EnerSys offers a number of customer-facing web tools (Battery Sizing Program, Motive Power configurator, CARB Compliance Calculator) and product-level telemetry such as the Wi-iQ battery monitoring system and NexSys iON connected fleet platform, no public developer APIs or open specifications have been published as of this index.

providers.name: EQT Corporation
providers.description: EQT Corporation is the largest producer of natural gas in the United States, headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. EQT operates in the Appalachian Basin and combines exploration and production technology with environmental stewardship initiatives, including a Scope 1 and Scope 2 net-zero commitment. EQT does not maintain a public developer program or open APIs; data access is limited to investor relations, ESG reporting, and partner-facing portals such as Equitrans Midstream customer services.

providers.name: Hawaiian Electric Industries
providers.description: Hawaiian Electric Industries (HEI) is a Hawaii-based holding company whose primary subsidiaries provide electric utility service to roughly 95% of Hawaii's residents through Hawaiian Electric, and clean-energy investments through Pacific Current. HEI does not publish public developer APIs at this time; this index tracks the company and its subsidiaries for API discovery purposes.

providers.name: Hess Corporation
providers.description: Hess Corporation was an independent global energy company engaged in the exploration, development, production, transportation, purchase, and sale of crude oil, natural gas liquids, and natural gas. Its core operations centered on onshore unconventional production in the Bakken Shale of North Dakota and a major offshore position in the Stabroek Block in Guyana, with additional interests in the Gulf of Mexico, Canada, and Southeast Asia. Chevron Corporation completed its $53 billion all-stock acquisition of Hess on July 18, 2025, after a regulatory and arbitration delay that included a Federal Trade Commission consent order barring former CEO John B. Hess from serving on Chevron's board and a parallel ExxonMobil/CNOOC arbitration over Guyana right-of-first-refusal claims. Hess is now a wholly-owned subsidiary of Chevron, and the ONE GUYANA FPSO at Stabroek has come online to produce approximately 250,000 barrels of oil per day. Hess Corporation has never offered public developer APIs; its technology integrations were handled through enterprise partner systems and joint-venture operator portals.

providers.name: HF Sinclair
providers.description: HF Sinclair is an independent energy company that produces and markets gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, specialty lubricant products, and renewable diesel fuel through refineries and a brand network of branded fuel stations.

providers.name: Icahn Enterprises
providers.description: Icahn Enterprises L.P. is a diversified holding company engaged in the investment, energy, automotive, food packaging, real estate, home fashion, and pharmaceutical industries through its operating subsidiaries. The company does not currently publish public developer APIs; investor relations, SEC filings, and corporate communications are provided through its corporate website.

providers.name: Level 3 Communications
providers.description: Level 3 Communications was a multinational telecommunications and Internet service provider that operated one of the largest fiber networks in the world, delivering Tier-1 IP transit, managed services, and content delivery. In 2017 it was acquired by CenturyLink, which later rebranded the combined company as Lumen Technologies. No public API program is documented under the legacy Level 3 brand.

providers.name: Liberty Energy
providers.description: Liberty Energy Inc (NYSE: LBRT), formerly Liberty Oilfield Services, is a Denver-based energy services company. It is one of the largest providers of completion services (hydraulic fracturing, wireline, sand and logistics) to onshore oil, natural gas, and enhanced geothermal producers in North America, and it is rapidly pivoting into distributed power generation for data centers and AI infrastructure via its Liberty Power Innovations (LPI) subsidiary. Founded in 2011 by Chris Wright, who left in 2025 to become the 17th US Secretary of Energy under the Trump administration. Ron Gusek is now President and CEO. The company does not publish any public developer APIs; this profile documents the organization, its proprietary internal platforms (FracTrends, Sentinel, digiTechnologies), and the Liberty Power data center pivot.

providers.name: Marathon Petroleum
providers.description: Marathon Petroleum is one of the largest petroleum product refiners, transporters, and marketers in the United States, with operations including refineries, pipelines, terminals, and retail outlets. No public developer APIs have been identified at this time.

providers.name: National Oilwell Varco
providers.description: National Oilwell Varco (NOV) is a global provider of equipment, technology, and services for the oil and gas drilling industry. NOV designs and manufactures rigs, drilling tools, downhole equipment, and provides digital solutions for drilling operations worldwide.

providers.name: New Jersey Resources
providers.description: New Jersey Resources (NJR) is a Fortune 1000 energy services holding company that provides natural gas distribution through New Jersey Natural Gas, retail energy services, midstream assets, and clean energy investments. No public APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: NextEra Energy
providers.description: NextEra Energy, Inc. is a Fortune 500 American energy company and one of the largest electric utility holding companies in the United States. It is the world's largest generator of renewable energy from the wind and sun, and a world leader in battery storage. NextEra Energy operates principally through its two subsidiaries, Florida Power & Light (FPL) and NextEra Energy Resources. This repository captures the public-facing digital surface, corporate touchpoints, and any developer or data resources for NextEra Energy. No public REST APIs, developer portal, or machine-readable data feeds have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Par Pacific Holdings
providers.description: Par Pacific Holdings is an entrepreneurial liquid fuels company focused on owning and operating energy and infrastructure businesses in logistically- complex markets. The company operates refining, retail, and logistics businesses across Hawaii, Washington, Wyoming, and Montana, with retail brands including 76, Hele, and nomnom.

providers.name: PBF Energy
providers.description: PBF Energy is one of the largest independent petroleum refiners and suppliers of unbranded transportation fuels, heating oils, lubricants, petrochemical feedstocks, and other petroleum products in the United States, operating refineries and a logistics network across the country.

providers.name: Plains GP Holdings
providers.description: Plains GP Holdings owns an interest in Plains All American Pipeline, a publicly traded master limited partnership that owns and operates midstream energy infrastructure in the United States and Canada. No public developer API or developer portal has been published; this repository tracks corporate and investor resources.

providers.name: PPL
providers.description: PPL Corporation is a U.S. energy company that delivers electricity and natural gas to customers through its regulated utilities in Pennsylvania, Kentucky, and Rhode Island. PPL is a Fortune 500 company.

providers.name: Praxair
providers.description: Praxair was an American multinational industrial gases company that merged with Linde AG in 2018 to form Linde plc. Praxair operations in the United States now operate as Linde. The company supplies atmospheric, process, and specialty gases, along with related equipment and services to a range of industries.

providers.name: ProPetro Holding
providers.description: ProPetro Holding Corp (NYSE: PUMP) is a Midland, Texas-based oilfield services company that "provides hydraulic fracturing and other complementary services to leading upstream oil and gas companies engaged in the exploration and production of North American unconventional oil and natural gas resources," operating principally in the Permian Basin. Service lines include hydraulic fracturing, the FORCE electric fleet (eFleet), Silvertip Wireline, cementing, PROPWR power solutions, and Aqua Prop water management. ProPetro does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or technology developer portal.

providers.name: Quanta Services
providers.description: Quanta Services is a Fortune 500 specialty contracting company that delivers infrastructure solutions to the electric power, renewable energy, oil and gas, pipeline, and communications industries throughout North America and Australia.

providers.name: Spectra Energy
providers.description: Spectra Energy was a Fortune 500 American energy company headquartered in Houston, Texas, focused on natural gas transmission and storage, distribution, and gathering and processing. Founded in 2007 as a spin-off from Duke Energy, Spectra Energy operated the Texas Eastern Pipeline and other major North American natural gas infrastructure. In February 2017, Spectra Energy was acquired by Enbridge Inc. in an all-stock deal valued at approximately $28 billion and no longer operates as an independent entity.

providers.name: Targa Resources
providers.description: Targa Resources Corp. is a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 midstream energy infrastructure company and one of the largest independent midstream companies in North America. The company provides midstream services including gathering, compression, treating, processing, and selling of natural gas; fractionating, treating, transporting, and selling of natural gas liquids (NGLs); gathering, storing, terminaling and selling crude oil; and storing and selling refined petroleum products. Targa operates primarily in the Permian Basin, Anadarko Basin, and South Texas production areas, and owns the Grand Prix NGL Pipeline.

providers.name: UGI Corporation
providers.description: UGI Corporation (NYSE: UGI) is a King of Prussia, Pennsylvania-based natural gas and electric utility and propane distribution company. UGI Utilities serves Pennsylvania natural gas and electric customers, AmeriGas is the largest retail propane distributor in the United States, and UGI International markets LPG across Europe through brands including Antargaz, Flaga, and AvantiGas. The corporation also operates midstream and energy marketing businesses. No public developer portal, OpenAPI specs, or third-party developer APIs have been identified. Customer self-service runs on a Smart Energy Water (SEW)-powered Online Account Center (Android package com.sew.ugi) with CheckFree Pay handling bill payments; AmeriGas operates the separate MyAmeriGas portal at myamerigas.com. Large commercial customers use an Oracle APEX-based TCP platform at apex.ugi.com. UGI Utilities is not listed as a supported utility by UtilityAPI or other Green Button aggregators at the time of profiling.

providers.name: Boise Cascade
providers.description: Boise Cascade is a leading North American manufacturer and distributor of building materials for the residential and commercial construction industry. The company produces engineered wood products (EWP) including I-joists, LVL beams, and glulam, as well as structural panels and lumber, and distributes a broad range of building materials through its wholesale distribution network.

providers.name: BorgWarner
providers.description: BorgWarner is a global automotive supplier designing and manufacturing propulsion systems, thermal management, battery systems, charging solutions, and power electronics for combustion, hybrid, and electric vehicles. The company accelerates the world's transition to clean, efficient mobility across passenger and commercial vehicle markets.

providers.name: Colony Capital (DigitalBridge Group)
providers.description: Colony Capital was a diversified real estate and hospitality investment firm founded by Tom Barrack in 1991. In June 2021 the company rebranded as DigitalBridge Group, Inc. (NYSE: DBRG) — completing a multi-year pivot from traditional real estate to pure-play digital infrastructure investing. The Boca Raton, FL-based alternative asset manager now operates exclusively across five digital infrastructure categories: data centers, macro cell towers, fiber networks, small cells, and edge infrastructure. DigitalBridge manages approximately $119B in assets across 45+ portfolio companies including Vantage Data Centers, DataBank, Switch, Vertical Bridge, Zayo Group, GD Towers, Boingo Wireless, AtlasEdge, Scala Data Centers, Yondr Group, and ExteNet Systems. In December 2025 SoftBank Group announced a definitive agreement to acquire DigitalBridge for approximately $4 billion, with the deal expected to close in the second half of 2026. DigitalBridge itself publishes no developer API, SDK, or public OpenAPI surface — it is a holding company whose programmable surface lives inside its individual portfolio companies (e.g., Zayo, DataBank, Switch), each of which is profiled separately in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Danaher
providers.description: Danaher Corporation is a global life sciences and diagnostics conglomerate whose operating companies include Beckman Coulter, Leica Microsystems, Cepheid, SCIEX, IDT, Cytiva, Abcam, Aldevron, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, Radiometer, and others. Danaher itself does not publish a corporate-level developer API; product and service APIs are provided by individual operating companies under the Danaher portfolio.

providers.name: FMC Corporation
providers.description: FMC Corporation is a Philadelphia-headquartered global agricultural sciences company that develops and supplies crop protection products including herbicides, insecticides, fungicides, and biological solutions, alongside precision agriculture technology. Originally founded as the Food Machinery Corporation, the modern FMC focuses on productivity and resilience for growers worldwide. This repository tracks the FMC Corporation entity and any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts. No public APIs or developer programs are currently published. Note that "FMC" is also commonly used as an abbreviation for the legacy FMC Technologies brand (now TechnipFMC), which is tracked separately under the fmc-technologies repository.

providers.name: Graham Holdings
providers.description: Graham Holdings (NYSE: GHC) is a diversified holding company with operations in education, television broadcasting, digital media, manufacturing, healthcare, automotive, restaurants, and custom framing. Principal subsidiaries include Kaplan (educational services), Graham Media Group and Social News Desk (broadcasting and social media tools), The Slate Group and Foreign Policy (digital publishing), Code3 and City Cast (digital marketing and local news), Hoover Treated Wood Products, Joyce/Dayton, Group Dekko, and Forney (manufacturing), Graham Healthcare Group (home health and hospice), Graham Automotive (dealerships), Clyde's Restaurant Group (including Old Ebbitt Grill), and Framebridge (online custom framing). No public developer APIs have been identified across the portfolio.

providers.name: Granite Construction
providers.description: Granite Construction is one of the largest diversified heavy civil contractors and construction materials producers in the United States, with operations spanning transportation infrastructure, water infrastructure, mineral exploration, and aggregate materials.

providers.name: Graphic Packaging
providers.description: Graphic Packaging International is a Fortune 500 global manufacturer of sustainable, paperboard-based consumer packaging. Products include folding cartons, multipack cartons, foodservice packaging (cups, lids, to-go containers), microwave and ovenable packaging, paperboard canisters, and packaging machinery. Markets served include food, beverage, foodservice, household, personal care, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, pet care, beauty, and e-commerce. No public developer APIs are documented at this time.

providers.name: Hormel Foods
providers.description: Hormel Foods Corporation is a global branded food company with over $12 billion in annual revenue. Known for brands like SPAM, Skippy, Jennie-O, Hormel, and Planters. The company produces and markets a wide range of meat, nut, and food products. No public APIs were identified.

providers.name: Huntsman Corporation
providers.description: Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global chemical manufacturer of differentiated and specialty chemicals serving a diverse range of consumer and industrial end markets, with operating segments in polyurethanes, performance products, and advanced materials. Huntsman maintains a Technology Portal for partner collaborations, but no public developer APIs have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Intuitive Surgical
providers.description: Intuitive Surgical is the global leader in robotic-assisted minimally invasive surgery, developing and marketing the da Vinci surgical system, Ion endoluminal system, and the Intuitive Hub for case management, streaming, and integration in operating rooms worldwide.

providers.name: KAR Auction Services (Historical)
providers.description: KAR Auction Services was a leading provider of vehicle auction, vehicle remarketing, and salvage auction services in North America. The company divested its salvage business IAA in 2023 (now part of RB Global) and rebranded its remaining wholesale business as OPENLANE. This repository is retained for historical reference. For current activity see the OPENLANE repository.

providers.name: Kenvue
providers.description: Kenvue is the world's largest pure-play consumer health company by revenue, formed from the consumer health spin-off of Johnson & Johnson. Everyday care is a powerful catalyst in making you feel better, inside and out. Kenvue's iconic brands include Tylenol, Neutrogena, Listerine, Aveeno, Band-Aid, and Johnson's.

providers.name: Lear
providers.description: Lear Corporation is a Fortune 500 global automotive technology leader in Seating and E-Systems, delivering complete seat systems, electrical distribution and connection systems, and intelligent in-vehicle technology to vehicles from major automakers worldwide. No public REST APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Leucadia National
providers.description: Leucadia National Corporation was a diversified holding company engaged in a variety of businesses, including investment banking, beef processing, manufacturing, telecommunications, and real estate. In 2018 it was renamed Jefferies Financial Group following the merger with Jefferies Group LLC. No public API program is documented under the legacy Leucadia National brand.

providers.name: Liberty Interactive
providers.description: Liberty Interactive Corporation owned and operated a broad range of video and online commerce companies, including QVC, HSN, and zulily, before being reorganized into Qurate Retail Group in 2018. The corporation tracked separate operating units through Liberty Interactive Group and Liberty Ventures Group tracking stocks.

providers.name: LifePoint Health
providers.description: LifePoint Health is a leading healthcare provider operating community hospitals, regional health systems, physician practices, outpatient centers, and post-acute facilities across the United States. This index tracks any APIs, SDKs, and developer resources published by LifePoint Health.

providers.name: LKQ Corporation
providers.description: LKQ Corporation is a Fortune 500 company and a leading provider of alternative and specialty parts to repair and accessorize automobiles and other vehicles, with operations across North America, Europe, and Taiwan. LKQ does not currently expose a public developer portal or REST API; this repository captures publicly available company and partner-program references.

providers.name: Martin Marietta Materials
providers.description: Martin Marietta Materials is a leading supplier of building materials, including aggregates, cement, ready-mixed concrete, asphalt, and paving products, used in construction, infrastructure, and residential projects across the United States.

providers.name: Oscar Health
providers.description: Oscar Health is a technology-driven health insurance company offering individual, small group, and Medicare Advantage plans. It uses software, member-facing apps, and data to make health insurance simpler and more consumer friendly.

providers.name: Packaging Corporation of America
providers.description: Packaging Corporation of America (PCA) is the third largest producer of containerboard and corrugated packaging products in the United States, supplying packaging to food, beverage, and industrial customers. No public APIs have been documented at this time.

providers.name: Packaging Corporation of America
providers.description: Packaging Corporation of America (PCA) is the third largest producer of containerboard and corrugated packaging products in the United States, supplying packaging to food, beverage, and industrial customers. No public APIs have been documented at this time.

providers.name: Public Storage
providers.description: Public Storage is an American real estate investment trust (REIT) that acquires, develops, owns, and operates self-storage facilities throughout the United States and Europe. Headquartered in Glendale, California, it is one of the largest self-storage operators in the world, serving customers via its online reservation system (eRental), mobile apps, and physical facilities. No public developer APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Spirit AeroSystems Holdings
providers.description: Spirit AeroSystems Holdings is one of the world's largest manufacturers of aerostructures for commercial airplanes, defense platforms, and business and regional jets. Spirit designs and builds fuselages, pylons, nacelles, and wing components for major aircraft programs including Boeing 737 MAX, 787, and Airbus A350. The company does not publicly expose developer APIs; its digital operations are focused on internal supply chain, manufacturing execution, and enterprise systems.

providers.name: Team Health Holdings
providers.description: TeamHealth Holdings is one of the largest physician practice organizations in the United States, providing outsourced healthcare professional staffing and administrative services to hospitals and other healthcare providers. Through more than 15,000 affiliated healthcare professionals and advanced practice clinicians, TeamHealth offers emergency medicine, hospital medicine, critical care, anesthesiology, orthopedic surgery, general surgery, obstetrics, ambulatory care, post-acute care, and medical call center solutions to approximately 3,000 acute and post-acute facilities and physician groups nationwide. TeamHealth does not maintain a public-facing developer API.

providers.name: Toll Brothers
providers.description: Toll Brothers is the nation's leading builder of luxury homes, designing, building, marketing, and arranging financing for luxury residential communities across the United States. As a Fortune 500 company and #1 Most Admired Home Builder in Fortune magazine's 2026 list, Toll Brothers operates across 60+ markets. The company does not publicly expose developer APIs. Website integrations and home search functionality are provided through the tollbrothers.com consumer platform.

providers.name: Halliburton
providers.description: Halliburton delivers advanced products and services to meet the evolving needs of the global energy industry, driving innovation, reliability, and performance. Halliburton operates enterprise software platforms such as DecisionSpace 365, Landmark, and iEnergy, but does not currently publish a public, openly accessible REST API for general developer use.

providers.name: MRC Global
providers.description: MRC Global is the largest global distributor of pipe, valve, and fitting products and services to the energy and industrial markets.

providers.name: NOV
providers.description: NOV is a Fortune 500 company providing equipment and components used in oil and gas drilling and production operations, oilfield services, and industrial and renewable energy sectors. This repository captures the APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts for NOV.

providers.name: Patterson-UTI Energy
providers.description: Patterson-UTI Energy is a leading provider of onshore contract drilling services to exploration and production companies in North America, with land-based drilling rigs and pressure pumping services. No public developer API has been identified at this time.

providers.name: Genworth Financial
providers.description: Genworth Financial is a Fortune 500 insurance holding company providing long-term care insurance, life insurance, annuities, and mortgage insurance products primarily in the United States.

providers.name: Lockheed Martin
providers.description: Lockheed Martin is a leading global security, defense, and aerospace contractor. This repository captures the public APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts where they exist for Lockheed Martin.

providers.name: Merck
providers.description: At Merck, we're following the science to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats. Get a glimpse of how we work to improve lives. No public APIs or developer portal have been identified for Merck.

providers.name: Parexel International
providers.description: Parexel International is one of the largest global biopharmaceutical services companies in the world, providing services that help clients accelerate the discovery and development of new therapies. No public developer API has been documented at this time.

providers.name: Tutor Perini
providers.description: Tutor Perini Corporation is a leading civil, building, and specialty construction company offering diversified general contracting, construction management, and design-build services to private and public customers worldwide. The company operates three segments: Civil, Building, and Specialty Contractors, serving transportation, water, power, and government markets. Tutor Perini does not publicly expose developer APIs.

providers.name: Berry Plastics Group
providers.description: Berry Plastics Group was a manufacturer and marketer of plastic packaging products, nonwoven specialty materials, and engineered materials serving customers across consumer and industrial markets. The company was renamed Berry Global Group in 2017 to reflect its global operations and diversified product portfolio beyond plastics. As Berry Global, the company subsequently merged with Amcor in 2024.

providers.name: BMC Stock Holdings
providers.description: BMC Stock Holdings, Inc. was one of the largest professional building materials distributors in the United States, serving homebuilders, remodelers, and contractors with lumber, structural components, millwork, doors, windows, and installed services. The company was formed in December 2015 through the merger of Stock Building Supply and Building Materials Holding Corporation (BMHC) and traded on NASDAQ under the ticker BMCH, headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina. On January 1, 2021, BMC Stock Holdings completed an all-stock "merger of equals" with Builders FirstSource (NYSE: BLDR), creating the nation's largest supplier of structural building products to the professional homebuilding market. The combined company retained the Builders FirstSource name, BLDR ticker, and Irving, Texas headquarters. The merger had an enterprise value of approximately $2.5 billion and produced a company with more than $11 billion in annual sales, approximately 26,000 employees, and roughly 550 distribution and manufacturing locations across more than 40 U.S. states. BMC Stock Holdings no longer exists as an independent entity. The legacy buildwithbmc.com domain redirects to bldr.com, and BMC product lines and branches have been absorbed into the Builders FirstSource network. This profile is retained as a historical Fortune 1000 record (BMC ranked #677 prior to the merger) and as a redirect to the successor profile at api-evangelist/builders-firstsource. BMC operated as a commodity-and-services distributor and did not publish public developer APIs, OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, or a developer portal. No API surface is documented for this provider.

providers.name: Boston Properties (BXP)
providers.description: BXP (formerly Boston Properties) is the largest publicly traded developer, owner, and manager of premier workplaces in the United States. The company develops, owns, and manages Class A office properties across six major U.S. markets: Boston, Los Angeles, New York, San Francisco, Seattle, and Washington DC. BXP is a self-administered and self-managed REIT focused on premier urban workspace.

providers.name: Boyd Gaming
providers.description: Boyd Gaming is a multi-jurisdictional casino entertainment company that owns and operates 28+ gaming properties across 10 U.S. states. The company offers casino gaming, hotel accommodations, dining, entertainment, and sports betting through its Boyd Sports platform. Boyd Rewards is the company's loyalty program spanning all properties, accessible via web portal and mobile app.

providers.name: Chemtura
providers.description: Chemtura Corporation was a global specialty chemicals company that developed, manufactured, and marketed chemical intermediates, additives, specialty chemicals, urethanes, organometallics, and modern plastics. In April 2017, Chemtura was acquired by LANXESS AG, the German specialty chemicals company headquartered in Cologne, and its operations were integrated into LANXESS's Performance Materials and other business segments. Chemtura products are now marketed and supported through LANXESS, which continues to serve agriculture, animal care, mobility, consumer goods, electrical and electronics, energy, food, and healthcare end markets.

providers.name: Commercial Metals Company
providers.description: Commercial Metals Company (CMC) is a Fortune 500 manufacturer, recycler, and marketer of steel and metal products serving the construction, energy, and manufacturing industries. CMC was the first US steel company to launch an online customer portal (myCMC), but does not currently publish a public developer API portal or OpenAPI specifications. Programmatic integrations with myCMC (order management, shipping, invoicing) are typically established through direct contracts with CMC's IT organization rather than via a self-service developer program.

providers.name: Computer Sciences Corporation
providers.description: Computer Sciences Corporation (CSC) was a multinational information technology services and professional services company. On April 1, 2017, CSC merged with the Enterprise Services line of business of Hewlett Packard Enterprise to form DXC Technology, retiring the standalone CSC brand. This profile is preserved as a historical record; CSC did not publish any public developer APIs and the entity is no longer actively operated under this name.

providers.name: Dean Foods
providers.description: Dean Foods was a leading U.S. food and beverage company and one of the largest processors and direct-to-store distributors of fresh fluid milk and other dairy products. After filing for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in 2019, most of Dean Foods' assets were acquired by Dairy Farmers of America (DFA) in 2020. Dean Foods no longer operates as an independent company and does not publish a public developer API; surviving brands are now managed under DFA. This profile is retained for historical reference.

providers.name: DISH Network
providers.description: DISH Network is a U.S. television provider offering satellite and streaming TV services, as well as wireless services through its Boost Mobile and DISH Wireless brands. DISH is now part of EchoStar following the 2024 merger that brought DISH and Hughes back together under one parent. No public consumer-facing developer APIs are documented; the Boost Mobile and DISH Wireless networks are operated on a 5G Open RAN architecture.

providers.name: EchoStar
providers.description: EchoStar Corporation (Nasdaq: SATS) is a global, fully integrated communications and content delivery leader and provider of technology, spectrum, and connectivity. Through its DISH, Boost Mobile, Hughes, and EchoStar Mobile brands, EchoStar delivers satellite communications, wireless services, and IoT connectivity to consumers, enterprises, governments, and aviation customers worldwide.

providers.name: Ecolab
providers.description: Ecolab is a Fortune 500 global leader in water, hygiene, and infection prevention solutions and services. The company helps customers in food, healthcare, hospitality, industrial, and energy markets keep their environments clean, safe, and healthy while protecting people and vital resources.

providers.name: Entergy
providers.description: Entergy Corporation is an integrated energy company headquartered in New Orleans, Louisiana, providing electricity to more than 3 million utility customers across Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, and Texas. The company operates power generation, transmission, and distribution infrastructure including nuclear, renewable, and hydroelectric resources. While Entergy does not publish a public developer API portal, it operates customer-facing digital tools (myEntergy account portal, outage map, energy efficiency toolkit) that interact with internal systems via private APIs.

providers.name: Fastenal
providers.description: Fastenal is a leading distributor of industrial and construction supplies, offering fasteners, tools, safety equipment, and other industrial products through stores, vending, and e-commerce. While Fastenal provides EDI integrations and supply chain programs like FAST 360, FASTBin, and FASTStock to enterprise customers, no publicly documented API specifications are available.

providers.name: Ferguson
providers.description: Ferguson is a Fortune 500 distributor of plumbing supplies, HVAC products, pipe, valves and fittings, waterworks, and building supplies serving professional contractors, residential homeowners, and commercial customers across the United States.

providers.name: Fortune Brands Innovations
providers.description: Fortune Brands Innovations (formerly Fortune Brands Home & Security) is a leading home products company with a portfolio of brands across water innovations (Moen, House of Rohl, Aqualisa), outdoors (Therma-Tru, Larson, Fiberon), and security (Master Lock, SentrySafe, Yale Residential).

providers.name: Fossil Group
providers.description: Fossil Group is a global designer, marketer, and distributor of consumer fashion accessories including watches, jewelry, handbags, small leather goods, belts, and sunglasses sold under owned and licensed brands such as Fossil, Skagen, Michele, Relic, Misfit, and licensed lines for Michael Kors, Diesel, Emporio Armani, Tory Burch, and others.

providers.name: Freeport-McMoRan
providers.description: Freeport-McMoRan is a leading international mining company with headquarters in Phoenix, Arizona, operating large, long-lived geographically diverse assets with significant proven and probable reserves of copper, gold, and molybdenum.

providers.name: General Cable
providers.description: General Cable Corporation was a global developer and manufacturer of copper, aluminum, and fiber optic wire and cable products. The company was acquired by Prysmian Group in 2018 and integrated into the Prysmian portfolio. No public developer APIs are documented for General Cable.

providers.name: General Growth Properties
providers.description: General Growth Properties (GGP) was a major U.S.-based commercial real estate company and the second-largest shopping mall operator in the United States before being acquired by Brookfield Property Partners in 2018. The GGP portfolio is now operated under Brookfield Properties. No public developer APIs are documented for the legacy GGP entity.

providers.name: Go Deed
providers.description: Go Deed (legally Deed Inc.) is a workplace-giving and corporate social responsibility platform founded in 2016 that helps enterprises engage employees around volunteering, charitable giving, donation matching, and everyday social-impact actions. With teams in New York, San Francisco, and Berlin, Deed served Fortune 500 and mid-market employers before being acquired into Bonterra, where it now ships as the "Deed" employee-engagement product. The joindeed.com domain 301-redirects to bonterratech.com/product/deed. Deed was surfaced as an Earlybird Venture Capital portfolio company (investment 2021) and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead. Enrichment found no independent public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API specification for the standalone Go Deed / Deed brand.

providers.name: Good Technology
providers.description: Good Technology was an enterprise mobile security company whose Good Dynamics platform provided app-level encryption, data loss prevention, secure inter-app communication, and a secure application-development SDK/API used by ISVs, systems integrators, and enterprises to build secured mobile apps across iOS and Android. The company served more than 6,200 organizations, including over half of the Fortune 100. Good Technology was acquired by BlackBerry in October 2015 for approximately $425 million and folded into BlackBerry's enterprise mobility (UEM) portfolio; it no longer operates as an independent entity and its former developer surface (good.com) now redirects to blackberry.com. This profile is retained as a historical company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Greif
providers.description: Greif is an industrial packaging products and services leader with a vision to be the best performing customer service company in the world. Greif also offers digital tools such as the Greif Green Tool carbon footprint calculator and the Greif+ online platform for customers.

providers.name: Hain Celestial Group
providers.description: The Hain Celestial Group is a leading organic and natural products company providing consumers with A Healthier Way of Life through a portfolio of natural, organic, and better-for-you brands. No public APIs or developer programs have been identified for Hain Celestial Group at this time.

providers.name: Hawaiian Holdings
providers.description: Hawaiian Holdings was the parent company of Hawaiian Airlines, the largest and longest-serving airline of Hawaii, providing scheduled passenger service to destinations across the Pacific. In 2024 the company combined with Alaska Air Group, and Hawaiian Holdings became a wholly-owned subsidiary of Alaska Air Group. No public developer portal or production-facing APIs are advertised.

providers.name: Hexion
providers.description: Hexion is a global leader in thermosetting resins, providing a broad range of adhesive, structural, and specialty resins to a wide variety of industries including coatings, construction, electronics, and automotive. Their purpose is to activate science to change our world.

providers.name: iHeartMedia
providers.description: iHeartMedia is America's #1 audio company, reaching 9 out of 10 Americans every month through broadcast radio, digital streaming, podcasts, live events, and on-demand entertainment. Public API documentation, developer programs, or open API artifacts have not been identified for iHeartMedia. This repository exists to track APIs, SDKs, and developer resources should they become available.

providers.name: Illinois Tool Works
providers.description: Illinois Tool Works (ITW) is a Fortune 500 global multi-industrial manufacturer of value-added consumables and specialty equipment with related service businesses across automotive OEM, food equipment, test and measurement, electronics, welding, polymers and fluids, construction products, and specialty products. ITW does not publish a public API or developer program. This repository exists to track APIs, SDKs, and developer resources should they become available.

providers.name: International Flavors & Fragrances
providers.description: International Flavors & Fragrances (IFF) is a global creator of flavors, fragrances, and ingredients for consumer products including perfumes, cosmetics, food, beverages, and household goods. IFF is a Fortune 500 company with no documented public developer API program at this time.

providers.name: International Paper
providers.description: International Paper is a Fortune 500 producer of fiber-based packaging, pulp, and paper products serving customers in more than 150 countries. The company does not currently publish a public developer API program; business integrations are handled through customer and supplier portals.

providers.name: J.M. Smucker
providers.description: The J.M. Smucker Company is a leading marketer and manufacturer of consumer food and beverage products and pet food and pet snacks in North America, with brands including Smucker's, Folgers, Jif, Milk-Bone, and Meow Mix.

providers.name: Jacobs Engineering Group
providers.description: Jacobs Engineering Group, now operating as Jacobs Solutions, is one of the world's largest providers of professional, technical, and construction services, offering full-spectrum support to industries including aerospace, energy, environmental, infrastructure, and transportation. This entry is retained for legacy continuity; current activity is tracked under Jacobs Solutions.

providers.name: Kansas City Southern
providers.description: Kansas City Southern (KCS) was a transportation holding company that operated freight rail networks across the United States and Mexico. On April 14, 2023, KCS merged with Canadian Pacific Railway to form Canadian Pacific Kansas City (CPKC), the first single-line rail network connecting Canada, the United States, and Mexico. CPKC operates approximately 32,000 km (20,000 mi) of rail and is headquartered in Calgary, Alberta, with U.S. headquarters in Kansas City, Missouri.

providers.name: KB Home
providers.description: KB Home is one of the largest and most recognized homebuilders in the United States, building single-family homes, townhomes, and condominiums for first-time, move-up, and active adult buyers across more than 45 markets.

providers.name: Kelly Services
providers.description: Kelly Services is a global leader in providing workforce solutions, connecting talented people to companies in need of their skills across a variety of industries including staffing, talent management, and outsourcing.

providers.name: Kennametal
providers.description: Kennametal is a leading provider of productivity solutions for metalworking, earth cutting, and wear components, coatings, and powders. Kennametal offers online integration services including Punch-Out / OCI (Open Catalog Interface), EDI, and a Product Data Portal for catalog and product information.

providers.name: Keurig Green Mountain
providers.description: Keurig Green Mountain was a leader in specialty coffee and coffee makers, producing the Keurig single-serve brewing system and partnering with leading coffee brands. In 2018 Keurig Green Mountain merged with Dr Pepper Snapple Group to form Keurig Dr Pepper, a Fortune 500 beverage company. This repository preserves the historical API and developer footprint of Keurig Green Mountain prior to that merger.

providers.name: L Brands
providers.description: L Brands was a Fortune 500 specialty retail holding company best known for Victoria's Secret, PINK, and Bath & Body Works. In 2021 the company split into two independent publicly traded companies, with Bath & Body Works, Inc. retaining the original NYSE listing and Victoria's Secret & Co. spun off as a standalone retailer. The L Brands brand is no longer in active use; this repository preserves the historical corporate record. No public developer API has been documented.

providers.name: Land O'Lakes
providers.description: Land O'Lakes is a member-owned agricultural cooperative providing food, agriculture, and animal nutrition products to farmers, retailers, and consumers, with brands including Land O'Lakes butter and Purina Animal Nutrition.

providers.name: Legg Mason
providers.description: Legg Mason was a global asset management firm offering investment products and services through a network of investment affiliates before being acquired by Franklin Resources (Franklin Templeton) in 2020. Investor resources and product information are now consolidated under Franklin Templeton, and no public REST APIs or developer portal have been identified.

providers.name: Levi Strauss
providers.description: Levi Strauss & Co. is one of the world's largest brand-name apparel companies and a global leader in jeanswear, designing and marketing jeans, casual wear, and related accessories under the Levi's, Dockers, Signature, and Denizen brands. The company does not publish a public developer API program.

providers.name: Manitowoc
providers.description: Manitowoc Cranes is one of the world's largest providers of lifting equipment for the global construction industry, including lattice-boom crawler cranes, tower cranes, mobile hydraulic cranes, and boom trucks. No public developer APIs have been documented.

providers.name: Manpower
providers.description: Manpower is a global workforce solutions brand of ManpowerGroup that delivers innovative staffing and workforce services to organizations worldwide and helps talent find meaningful, sustainable employment. No public developer APIs have been documented.

providers.name: ManpowerGroup
providers.description: ManpowerGroup is a global workforce solutions company that connects talented people with innovative companies through its family of brands including Manpower, Experis, and Talent Solutions. No public developer APIs have been documented.

providers.name: Masco Corporation
providers.description: Masco Corporation is a global leader in the design, manufacture, and distribution of branded home improvement and building products, including faucets, plumbing fixtures, cabinets, paints, and architectural coatings under brands such as Delta, Behr, Hansgrohe, KILZ, and Liberty Hardware.

providers.name: McCormick
providers.description: McCormick spices and products have been kitchen must-haves since 1889. Learn about seasoning and cuisine while discovering tons of delicious recipes today. No public developer APIs are currently documented.

providers.name: Mettler-Toledo International
providers.description: Mettler-Toledo is a global manufacturer of precision instruments and services for use in laboratories, manufacturing, and food retailing applications. This repository captures the APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts for Mettler-Toledo International.

providers.name: NTT DATA
providers.description: NTT DATA is a global IT services and consulting firm offering strategic consulting, cloud services, cybersecurity, data analytics, application development, and managed infrastructure across industries including banking, healthcare, manufacturing, public sector, and retail. The company operates in more than 50 countries and serves Fortune 500 enterprises with digital transformation, AI, and systems integration capabilities. NTT DATA does not publish a general public REST API; integrations are typically delivered through bespoke engagements and partner-specific solutions.

providers.name: Nucor
providers.description: Nucor Corporation is a Fortune 500 American steel and steel products manufacturer headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. It is the largest steel producer in the United States and the largest recycler of any material in North America. Nucor does not publish a public developer API or OpenAPI specification; this index captures the corporate, sustainability, and certification resources that are publicly available.

providers.name: Olin
providers.description: Olin Corporation is a leading global manufacturer and distributor of chemical products and ammunition. Olin operates three business segments: Chlor Alkali Products and Vinyls, Epoxy, and Winchester. No public APIs have been documented at this time.

providers.name: Penn National Gaming
providers.description: Penn National Gaming (now operating as Penn Entertainment) is one of the largest and most diversified regional gaming and racing companies in the United States, operating casinos and racetracks across multiple states. No public APIs have been documented at this time.

providers.name: Penske
providers.description: A diversified transportation services conglomerate operating truck leasing, logistics, automotive retail, and professional motorsports across North America. Penske Corporation spans Penske Truck Leasing (full-service leasing, rental, and contract maintenance), Penske Logistics (supply chain management, warehousing, distribution, dedicated contract carriage), Penske Automotive Group (retail automotive dealerships in the US, UK, Germany, Italy, Japan, Australia, and New Zealand), and Team Penske (motorsports). The corporate parent has 73,000+ employees and approximately $43B+ in consolidated revenue. Customer self-service is delivered through web and mobile portals (Penske Fleet Insight, Penske Truck Leasing app, Penske Truck Rental); Penske does not publish a public developer API or partner integration portal. Penske Automotive Group is the publicly traded subsidiary (NYSE - PAG).

providers.name: PPG Industries
providers.description: PPG Industries is a Fortune 500 global supplier of paints, coatings, and specialty materials serving customers in construction, consumer products, industrial, transportation markets, and aftermarkets. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with PPG Industries. As of the last review, no public APIs or developer portal have been identified.

providers.name: Precision Castparts
providers.description: Precision Castparts Corp. is a worldwide manufacturer of complex metal components and products including investment castings, forgings, and fasteners and structurals for aerospace and industrial gas turbine markets. The company is owned by Berkshire Hathaway.

providers.name: PulteGroup
providers.description: PulteGroup is one of America's largest homebuilding companies, building homes under the Centex, Pulte Homes, Del Webb, DiVosta Homes, John Wieland Homes, and American West brands. No public developer APIs have been identified at this time; this index tracks the company's public web properties.

providers.name: Ralph Lauren Corporation
providers.description: Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE: RL) is a global premium-lifestyle company founded by Ralph Lauren in 1967 and headquartered in New York City. The company designs, markets, and distributes apparel, accessories, home, and fragrances across a portfolio of brands including Polo Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Double RL (RRL), Lauren Ralph Lauren, and Chaps, along with Polo Golf, RLX, Pink Pony, Ralph Lauren Home and Paint, Ralph Lauren Watches and Fine Jewelry, and Ralph Lauren Restaurants. Direct-to-consumer commerce runs on Adobe Commerce, and category-extension brands are operated through licensing partners (eyewear via Luxottica, fragrances via L'Oréal). The corporation operates retail stores in dozens of countries with no publicly documented developer APIs, partner program portal, affiliate API, or open OpenAPI/Postman/GraphQL surface as of the profiling date.

providers.name: Skillbridge
providers.description: Skillbridge (skillbridge.co) was a New York-based online marketplace for freelance consultants and independent professionals, connecting organizations from Fortune 500 companies to early-stage startups with vetted specialists for short-term engagements. Founded in 2013, it was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company. Skillbridge was acquired by Toptal in 2016 and folded into what became Toptal Business; the skillbridge.co domain now 301-redirects to toptal.com/finance. The company operates no independent developer API, documentation, developer portal, SDKs, or event surface, so there are no technical artifacts to enrich.

providers.name: SuperValu
providers.description: SuperValu was one of the largest grocery retail and wholesale distribution companies in the United States before being acquired by United Natural Foods (UNFI) in 2018 for $2.9 billion. SuperValu operated retail grocery stores under multiple banners and provided wholesale distribution services. The supervalu.com domain now redirects to UNFI's wholesale food distribution platform. Suppliers interact with UNFI/SuperValu distribution through EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) and the myUNFI supplier portal.

providers.name: Tractor Supply
providers.description: Tractor Supply Company is the largest rural lifestyle retailer in the United States, providing products to support recreational farming, ranching, and country lifestyles. Tractor Supply integrates with suppliers and vendors via EDI and vendor portal systems, enabling order management, invoice processing, and shipment notifications. The company operates through its vendor transaction portal for supplier collaboration and EDI-based supply chain integrations.

providers.name: Trinity Industries
providers.description: Trinity Industries, Inc. is a leading manufacturer and lessor of railcars in North America, providing products and services to the industrial, energy, transportation, and construction sectors. The company designs, manufactures, leases, and manages railcars used to transport commodities such as energy products, agricultural goods, construction materials, and consumer staples. Trinity operates a lease fleet of over 140,000 owned and managed railcars through its TrinityRail division.

providers.name: Twenty-First Century Fox
providers.description: Twenty-First Century Fox was an American multinational mass media corporation that operated film, television, and cable assets before being largely acquired by The Walt Disney Company in 2019. Its remaining broadcasting and news assets continued under Fox Corporation. The company no longer exists as an independent entity and did not expose public developer APIs.

providers.name: Crane
providers.description: Crane Co. (NYSE: CR) and its sister company Crane NXT (NYSE: CXT) are industrial manufacturing companies that resulted from the 2023 split of the legacy Crane Holdings, Co. Crane Co. is a diversified manufacturer of highly engineered industrial products serving aerospace and electronics, process flow technologies, and engineered materials markets. Crane NXT is a global leader in trusted technology solutions for payment, security, and authentication including currency, banknote, and authentication products. No public APIs or developer portals are published; integrations with industrial customers are arranged through enterprise channels.

providers.name: New York Community Bancorp
providers.description: New York Community Bancorp, Inc. (now operating as Flagstar Financial) is a Fortune 500 bank holding company headquartered in Hicksville, New York. Through its banking subsidiary, the company provides commercial banking, multi-family lending, mortgage banking, and consumer banking services across the United States. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with the company.
