No public developer APIs or documentation portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: People's United Financial
providers.description: Defunct U.S. regional bank holding company, headquartered in Bridgeport, Connecticut. Acquired by M&T Bank Corporation in an all-stock deal valued at approximately $7.6 billion. The acquisition was announced February 22, 2021 and closed April 2, 2022. People's United operated roughly 403 branches at close and was fully integrated into M&T Bank by Q3 2022. The People's United brand has been retired; peoples.com now 301-redirects to mtb.com. No public developer program, OpenAPI definitions, SDKs, GitHub organization, or documented APIs existed at any point during its operating history.

providers.name: Xylem
providers.description: Xylem is a leading global water technology company committed to developing innovative technology solutions to the world's water challenges across the full water cycle.

providers.name: Dow
providers.description: Dow Inc. is a global materials science company headquartered in Midland, Michigan. Dow combines science and technology to develop innovative products and solutions for packaging, infrastructure, mobility, and consumer applications. This entry is an alias of dow-chemical and covers the same parent company.

providers.name: Erie Insurance
providers.description: Erie Insurance Group (NASDAQ: ERIE) is a Fortune 500 property and casualty insurance company headquartered in Erie, Pennsylvania. The company offers auto, home, business, and life insurance products through a network of independent agents across multiple U.S. states.

providers.name: Farmers Insurance Exchange
providers.description: Farmers Insurance Exchange is a Fortune 500 inter-insurance exchange and the largest member of the Farmers Insurance Group of Companies. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Farmers Insurance Exchange. No public APIs have been documented at this time.

providers.name: Gap
providers.description: Gap Inc. is a Fortune 500 American clothing and accessories retailer operating brands including Gap, Old Navy, Banana Republic, and Athleta. Gap does not publish a public developer API; this repository tracks the company, its public web presence, and any partner or technical artifacts that surface over time.

providers.name: Hanesbrands
providers.description: Hanesbrands is a global consumer apparel company designing, manufacturing, and selling everyday basic apparel under brands including Hanes, Champion, Bali, Maidenform, and Bonds. In 2025 Hanesbrands was acquired by Gildan, with both companies continuing to operate as a combined apparel leader.

providers.name: Jabil
providers.description: Jabil is a global manufacturing services company that provides engineering, supply chain, and manufactured product solutions for the world's leading brands across industries including automotive, healthcare, industrial, consumer electronics, networking, and cloud infrastructure.

providers.name: Macy's
providers.description: Macy's, Inc. is one of the nation's premier omnichannel retailers, operating department stores, websites, and apps under the Macy's, Bloomingdale's, and Bluemercury brands. This repository tracks any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts that are made publicly available by Macy's.

providers.name: Markel
providers.description: Markel provides specialty insurance coverage and creates seamless solutions across multiple types of insurance risks for the US market and around the globe. Markel is a Fortune 500 insurance company with operations spanning property, casualty, and specialty lines for businesses and individuals.

providers.name: Mosaic
providers.description: Mosaic is a brand experience agency offering experiential marketing, B2B corporate experiences, integrated commerce, and field sales and marketing services. The agency builds brand-building, conversion-driving experiences for clients across multiple channels.

providers.name: Neiman Marcus Group
providers.description: Neiman Marcus Group is an American chain of luxury department stores selling designer apparel, accessories, jewelry, beauty, home, and gifts under the Neiman Marcus, Bergdorf Goodman, and Last Call banners.

providers.name: Newell Brands
providers.description: Newell Brands is a Fortune 500 global consumer goods company with a strong portfolio of well-known brands including Rubbermaid, Sharpie, Graco, Coleman, Yankee Candle, Paper Mate, Parker, Elmer's, Oster, NUK, and Mr. Coffee.

providers.name: Newell Rubbermaid
providers.description: Newell Rubbermaid was a global marketer of consumer and commercial products with brands including Sharpie, Paper Mate, Rubbermaid, and Calphalon before merging with Jarden in 2016 to form Newell Brands.

providers.name: PACCAR
providers.description: PACCAR is a global technology leader in the design, manufacture, and customer support of premium light, medium, and heavy-duty trucks under the Kenworth, Peterbilt, and DAF nameplates. PACCAR also designs and manufactures advanced diesel engines, provides financial services and information technology, and distributes truck parts related to its principal business.

providers.name: QVC
providers.description: QVC is a multinational corporation specializing in televised home shopping owned by Qurate Retail Group, broadcasting to millions of households worldwide and offering products through television, mobile apps, and websites.

providers.name: Diamondback Energy
providers.description: Diamondback Energy is an independent oil and natural gas company focused on the acquisition, development, exploration, and exploitation of unconventional, onshore oil and natural gas reserves in the Permian Basin of West Texas. As a Fortune 500 company in the upstream energy sector, Diamondback does not currently publish a public developer portal or APIs; this repository is maintained as a placeholder for any APIs, developer tools, or machine-readable artifacts that may emerge.

providers.name: Envista Holdings
providers.description: Envista Holdings is a global family of dental products companies and a Fortune 1000 firm whose brands include Nobel Biocare, Ormco, KaVo, and Implant Direct. The company manufactures and supplies dental implants, orthodontic systems, imaging equipment, and consumables to clinicians worldwide. Envista does not publish a public, unified developer portal or external API; integrations are generally handled at the individual brand level for clinical software and imaging workflows.

providers.name: Great Plains Energy
providers.description: Great Plains Energy was the holding company of Kansas City Power & Light, an electric utility serving customers in Missouri and Kansas, before merging with Westar Energy in 2018 to form Evergy. No public APIs are documented.

providers.name: Green Plains
providers.description: Green Plains is a vertically integrated ethanol producer that operates ethanol plants, grain handling and storage facilities, and a cattle-feeding operation. No public APIs are documented.

providers.name: ITT
providers.description: ITT Inc. is a diversified leading manufacturer of highly engineered critical components and customized technology solutions for the transportation, industrial, and oil and gas markets.

providers.name: MasTec
providers.description: MasTec is a Fortune 500 infrastructure construction company operating across clean energy, data centers, EV infrastructure, pipelines, power generation and delivery, civil infrastructure, technology deployment, water and wastewater, and communications. No public developer portal or APIs have been identified.

providers.name: Monster Beverage
providers.description: Monster Beverage Corporation is a marketer and distributor of energy drinks and alternative beverages, offering brands including Monster Energy, Reign, NOS, Burn, Mother, Relentless, and Predator. It is a Fortune 500 company headquartered in Corona, California.

providers.name: National Fuel Gas Company
providers.description: National Fuel Gas Company is a diversified energy company engaged in natural gas distribution, gas pipeline and storage, gas exploration and production, and energy marketing across the northeastern United States. National Fuel Gas does not currently publish a documented public REST API or developer portal; customer information and operational disclosures are made available through its corporate website, investor relations channels, and FERC regulatory filings.

providers.name: NRG Energy
providers.description: NRG Energy is a Fortune 500 American energy company. This repository captures the APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts for NRG Energy. No public APIs have been documented at this time.

providers.name: ONEOK
providers.description: ONEOK is a Fortune 500 energy company providing midstream services to natural gas and natural gas liquids producers, processors, and customers. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with ONEOK.

providers.name: Ovintiv
providers.description: Ovintiv is a Fortune 500 oil and natural gas exploration and production company headquartered in Denver, Colorado. The company operates across North America with a focus on multi-basin development. This repository captures the APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Ovintiv.

providers.name: Peabody Energy
providers.description: Peabody Energy is the world's largest private-sector coal company, mining and supplying coal to electricity generators and steel producers in the United States and around the world. No public developer APIs are currently documented for this organization.

providers.name: Gilead Sciences
providers.description: Gilead Sciences is a research-based biopharmaceutical company that discovers, develops, and commercializes innovative therapeutics in areas of unmet medical need including HIV, viral hepatitis, oncology, and inflammatory diseases.

providers.name: NiSource
providers.description: NiSource is one of the largest fully-regulated utility companies in the United States, serving approximately 3.5 million natural gas and electric customers across six states through its operating subsidiaries Columbia Gas and NIPSCO.

providers.name: Office Depot
providers.description: Office Depot is a leading provider of business products and services delivering workplace solutions through retail stores, e-commerce sites, and a dedicated business-to-business sales organization.

providers.name: Playtika Holding
providers.description: Playtika Holding is an Israel-based mobile gaming company and Fortune 1000 firm that develops and publishes free-to-play casual and casino-themed games such as Slotomania, Bingo Blitz, and Caesars Slots. The company operates a portfolio of social and casual mobile gaming titles distributed through major app stores and uses data-driven engagement and live operations to monetize its global player base. Playtika does not publish a public developer portal or external API.

providers.name: Stagwell
providers.description: Stagwell is a digital-first global marketing services and technology company and a Fortune 1000 firm. The company operates a network of agencies and technology brands and offers the Stagwell Marketing Cloud (SMC), a suite of proprietary marketing technology products built by its in-house engineering teams. Stagwell does not publish a single unified public developer portal at the holding-company level; product APIs are exposed through individual SMC products.

providers.name: Exact Sciences
providers.description: Exact Sciences is a molecular diagnostics company and a Fortune 1000 firm best known for the Cologuard colorectal cancer screening test and the Oncotype DX family of cancer tests. The company develops, manufactures, and markets laboratory-based screening and precision oncology tests delivered to patients and providers through its Exact Labs operations. Exact Sciences does not publish a public developer portal or external API.

providers.name: Genuine Parts Company
providers.description: Genuine Parts Company is a Fortune 500 service organization engaged in the distribution of automotive replacement parts (the parent of NAPA Auto Parts), industrial replacement parts, and electrical materials and electronic components.

providers.name: Huntington Ingalls Industries
providers.description: Huntington Ingalls Industries is the largest military shipbuilding company in the United States, designing, building, overhauling, and repairing ships primarily for the U.S. Navy and Coast Guard, while also providing professional services including unmanned systems, defense solutions, and cybersecurity. No public developer APIs have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Keurig Dr Pepper (formerly Dr Pepper Snapple Group)
providers.description: Dr Pepper Snapple Group was an integrated brand owner, manufacturer, and distributor of nonalcoholic beverages in the United States, Canada, Mexico, and the Caribbean. In 2018 the company merged with Keurig Green Mountain to form Keurig Dr Pepper, a leading beverage company in North America with a portfolio of more than 150 brands including Dr Pepper, 7UP, Snapple, Canada Dry, Keurig, and Peet's Coffee.

providers.name: Landstar System
providers.description: Landstar System is a worldwide, asset-light provider of integrated transportation management solutions delivering safe, specialized transportation services to a broad range of customers.

providers.name: NewMarket Corporation
providers.description: NewMarket Corporation (NYSE: NEU) is a publicly traded specialty chemicals holding company headquartered in Richmond, Virginia. Through subsidiaries Afton Chemical and Ethyl Corporation, NewMarket develops petroleum additives for fuels and lubricants used worldwide.

providers.name: Oceaneering International
providers.description: Oceaneering International is a global provider of engineered services and products primarily to the offshore oil and gas industry, with a focus on deepwater applications.

providers.name: Post Holdings
providers.description: Post Holdings is a consumer packaged goods holding company with businesses in center-of-the-store, refrigerated, foodservice, food ingredient, and convenient nutrition product categories, with a brand portfolio that includes Post Consumer Brands, Bob Evans, Weetabix, and Michael Foods.

providers.name: Academy Sports and Outdoors
providers.description: Academy Sports + Outdoors is a Fortune 500 sporting goods and outdoor recreation retailer headquartered in Katy, Texas. The company operates retail stores across the United States and an e-commerce platform offering sporting equipment, apparel, footwear, hunting and fishing gear, camping supplies, and outdoor recreation products. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Academy Sports + Outdoors. No public developer APIs or documentation portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Allegheny Technologies
providers.description: Allegheny Technologies Incorporated (ATI) is an American producer of specialty materials headquartered in Dallas, Texas. ATI produces metals including titanium and titanium alloys, nickel-based alloys and superalloys, stainless and specialty steels, zirconium, hafnium, niobium, tungsten materials, forgings, and castings. The company serves aerospace and defense (over 50% of sales), oil and gas, chemical process industry, electrical energy, and medical markets. ATI generates approximately $4.6 billion in annual revenue and is listed on the NYSE (ticker: ATI). As a specialty materials manufacturer focused on advanced metals production, ATI does not maintain a public developer API program, but engages in EDI-based supply chain integrations with aerospace OEM customers including Boeing and Airbus.

providers.name: APi Group
providers.description: APi Group Corporation is a Fortune 500 global, market-leading business services provider of safety, specialty, and industrial services. The company delivers life safety, security, specialty trades, and industrial contracting services through a network of operating companies across North America, Europe, the Asia-Pacific region, and beyond. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with APi Group. No public developer APIs or documentation portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Coherent
providers.description: Coherent Corp. is a Fortune 500 global leader in materials, networking, and laser technologies. The company designs and manufactures engineered materials, optoelectronic components, optical transceivers, laser systems, and semiconductor manufacturing equipment for AI infrastructure, datacommunications, industrial, aerospace and defense, life sciences, and consumer electronics markets. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Coherent. No public developer APIs or documentation portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Concho Resources
providers.description: Concho Resources, Inc. was an independent oil and natural gas company focused on the acquisition, development, exploration, and production of oil and natural gas properties primarily in the Permian Basin of West Texas and southeast New Mexico. On January 15, 2021, ConocoPhillips completed an all-stock acquisition of Concho Resources at a total enterprise value of $13.3 billion, retiring the Concho brand. This profile is preserved as a historical record; Concho no longer operates under this name and never published any public developer APIs.

providers.name: DCP Midstream (Acquired by Phillips 66)
providers.description: DCP Midstream LLC was a Denver, Colorado-based natural gas gathering, processing, and NGL transportation company that operated as one of the largest U.S. producers and marketers of natural gas liquids. In June 2023, Phillips 66 completed the acquisition of all publicly traded common units of DCP Midstream LP for approximately $3.8 billion, taking its ownership stake to 86.8%. DCP Midstream and Phillips 66 Partners were subsequently merged into Phillips 66's NGL and midstream business; the standalone brand, public filings, developer surface, and corporate website have been retired. The dcpmidstream.com domain no longer resolves to a working site, and there is no public DCP-branded developer portal, API reference, status page, or changelog. This repository documents DCP Midstream as a defunct entity absorbed into the Phillips 66 midstream organization.

providers.name: Denbury Resources
providers.description: Denbury Resources (now Denbury Inc.) was an independent oil and natural gas company focused on enhanced oil recovery (EOR) using carbon dioxide injection in mature oil fields. Denbury was acquired by ExxonMobil in November 2023 and operates as a subsidiary inside ExxonMobil's Low Carbon Solutions business. Denbury does not publish public APIs; this profile is preserved as a corporate-history index.

providers.name: Diplomat Pharmacy
providers.description: Diplomat Pharmacy was an independent provider of specialty pharmacy services that helped patients with chronic and complex conditions access and manage specialty medications. The company was acquired by UnitedHealth Group's OptumRx, and operations have been integrated under that brand. No publicly documented developer APIs are offered under the Diplomat Pharmacy name.

providers.name: Energen
providers.description: Energen Corporation was a U.S. oil and natural gas exploration and production company headquartered in Birmingham, Alabama, with operations focused on the Permian Basin in west Texas and southeast New Mexico. In November 2018, Energen was acquired by Diamondback Energy in an all-stock transaction, and the Energen brand was retired as its assets were integrated into Diamondback. No public developer APIs are currently published; this repository preserves the corporate record.

providers.name: Energy Transfer Equity
providers.description: Energy Transfer Equity, L.P. (ETE) was a master limited partnership that owned and operated a diverse portfolio of midstream energy assets. In October 2018, ETE merged with its operating subsidiary Energy Transfer Partners (ETP) to form a single publicly traded partnership, Energy Transfer LP (NYSE: ET). All developer resources, including the Messenger+ API for pipeline messaging and gas scheduling, are now provided under the Energy Transfer LP brand.

providers.name: Lithia Motors
providers.description: Lithia Motors is one of the largest automotive retailers in the United States, operating new and used vehicle dealerships and providing related vehicle financing, service, and parts.

providers.name: Magellan Midstream Partners
providers.description: Magellan Midstream Partners owned the longest refined petroleum products pipeline system in the United States, along with refined petroleum products and crude oil storage facilities. Magellan Midstream Partners was acquired by ONEOK in September 2023 and its assets and operations have been integrated into ONEOK's Refined Products and Crude segment. This repository tracks any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts made publicly available related to the legacy Magellan operations or successor ONEOK resources.

providers.name: Nationstar Mortgage Holdings
providers.description: Nationstar Mortgage Holdings was a non-bank residential mortgage loan originator and servicer in the United States that was rebranded as Mr. Cooper Group.

providers.name: QEP Resources

providers.name: Renewable Energy Group

providers.name: Sierra Ventures
providers.description: Sierra Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm founded by Peter Wendell in 1982 and headquartered in San Mateo, California, in the heart of Silicon Valley. The firm invests from inception through Series A in first-principles founders under the tagline "Conviction Before Consensus," writing checks of up to $5M at seed and up to $10M at Series A. Sierra's current investment thesis centers on the next wave of enterprise technology: Vertical AI (purpose-built AI for specific industries), Infrastructure AI, Frontier and Deep Tech, and Physical AI and Robotics, alongside a longstanding history in enterprise applications, digital health, SaaS, and security. Over its 40-plus-year history the firm has invested more than $2 billion across 13 early-stage funds, with its 13th fund closing in 2023 at $265 million, following Fund 12 at $215 million and Fund 11 at $170 million. Sierra reports 35 IPOs and hundreds of successful exits, having backed companies such as Elastic, Astronomer, Chronosphere, CourseHero, Q-CTRL, Spectro Cloud, Endor Labs, and Reflection AI. The firm is notable for its CXO Advisory Board of Fortune 1000 enterprise leaders who help portfolio companies land early customers. This profile tracks Sierra Ventures' identity and its portfolio graph across the API Evangelist network.
